* **TOP NEWS**

"**Texas judge says state can't execute Robert Roberson, but attorney general plans to swiftly appeal** ," Texas Tribune's **Kayla Guo** -- "As Texas prison officials ready the death chamber to execute**Robert Roberson** on Thursday night, legal battles aimed at delaying his death continue to play out amid a thundering chorus of people who believe the state is about to kill an innocent man and hope last-minute measures will buy him more time.

On Thursday afternoon, a state district court judge in Travis County ruled that the state doesn't have the authority to execute Roberson if it prevents him from complying with a last-minute legislative subpoena. But the Texas Department of Criminal Justice said the attorney general's office plans to appeal the ruling to the state's highest criminal court, which has repeatedly shot down efforts to halt Roberson's execution.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/6619206a-e16f-445a-9b7c-fc2931b3cc50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That judge's ruling**** was in reaction to a Texas House committee's [stunning decision Wednesday to subpoena Roberson](https://substack.com/redirect/1725acf6-008f-4c60-bb9a-4bed06745c41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ahead of his Thursday execution, a step that sought to give the man a final lifeline after a series of court rejections left him on track to become the first person in the country executed for allegedly shaking a baby to death.

Roberson was convicted of killing his 2-year-old daughter, who was diagnosed with shaken baby syndrome. But experts, lawmakers and the lead detective in the girl's case say the science supporting Roberson's death sentence no longer holds up -- and the state's "junk science" law should have already halted his execution.

The subpoena "sets up a bit of a separation of powers issue," Benjamin Wolff, director of the Texas Office of Capital and Forensic Writs, said on Wednesday, adding that he had not seen this maneuver attempted before, so it was not clear what could happen. "It's an unprecedented subpoena and an unprecedented case."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/6619206a-e16f-445a-9b7c-fc2931b3cc50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
But at 5 p.m., an hour before Roberson's scheduled execution, it was unclear if that gambit would work. It could be his last chance, unless Gov. **Greg Abbott** steps in. The U.S. Supreme Court on Thursday afternoon declined to stop the execution, though Justice **Sonia Sotomayor** urged Abbott to issue a 30-day reprieve.

"That could prevent a miscarriage of justice from occurring: executing a man who has raised credible evidence of actual innocence," she wrote.
The Texas House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee approved its subpoena hours after the state's highest criminal court again declined to stop the execution, and after the Texas Board of Pardons and Parole denied Roberson's request for clemency. Gov. Greg Abbott cannot defy the board's recommendation, but he can issue a 30-day reprieve. Abbott has remained silent. Roberson's lawyers also filed last-minute attempts to halt the execution with a state district court, the state's highest criminal court and the U.S. Supreme Court.

In a Wednesday evening [filing](https://substack.com/redirect/5dbe289d-3b81-4e15-8257-002d939fca49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the high court, **Craig W. Cosper** , an assistant state attorney general, argues that Roberson's appeal is "unworthy of the Court's attention" and that there is no "compelling reason" to review the case.

Roberson's attorneys [responded](https://substack.com/redirect/3fb93a36-7836-4f71-a0aa-ef35f421ae7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the man was denied due process and that the state relies on "a litany of lies."" On Thursday afternoon, a state district court judge in Travis County ruled that the state doesn't have the authority to execute Roberson if it prevents him from complying with a last-minute legislative subpoena. But the Texas Department of Criminal Justice said the attorney general's office plans to appeal the ruling to the state's highest criminal court, which has repeatedly shot down efforts to halt Roberson's execution. That judge's ruling** was in reaction to a Texas House committee's ahead of his Thursday execution, a step that sought to give the man a final lifeline after a series of court rejections left him on track to become the first person in the country executed for allegedly shaking a baby to death. Roberson was convicted of killing his 2-year-old daughter, who was diagnosed with shaken baby syndrome. But experts, lawmakers and the lead detective in the girl's case say the science supporting Roberson's death sentence no longer holds up -- and the state's "junk science" law should have already halted his execution. The subpoena "sets up a bit of a separation of powers issue," Benjamin Wolff, director of the Texas Office of Capital and Forensic Writs, said on Wednesday, adding that he had not seen this maneuver attempted before, so it was not clear what could happen. "It's an unprecedented subpoena and an unprecedented case." But at 5 p.m., an hour before Roberson's scheduled execution, it was unclear if that gambit would work. It could be his last chance, unless Gov. Greg Abbott steps in. The U.S. Supreme Court on Thursday afternoon declined to stop the execution, though Justice Sonia Sotomayor urged Abbott to issue a 30-day reprieve. "That could prevent a miscarriage of justice from occurring: executing a man who has raised credible evidence of actual innocence," she wrote. The Texas House Criminal Jurisprudence Committee approved its subpoena hours after the state's highest criminal court again declined to stop the execution, and after the Texas Board of Pardons and Parole denied Roberson's request for clemency. Gov. Greg Abbott cannot defy the board's recommendation, but he can issue a 30-day reprieve. Abbott has remained silent. Roberson's lawyers also filed last-minute attempts to halt the execution with a state district court, the state's highest criminal court and the U.S. Supreme Court. In a Wednesday evening with the high court, Craig W. Cosper , an assistant state attorney general, argues that Roberson's appeal is "unworthy of the Court's attention" and that there is no "compelling reason" to review the case. body:
Anything worth fighting for is going to leave some bumps and bruises. But at the end of the day we'd rather have these scars from our work defending our right to vote than sit idly by and watch as our voices are silenced.
Team: Fight with us and RUSH $25 or more today because voting rights and our democracy are worth every effort we can muster in this election and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=101724_3&amount=25]
Team,
Some days the reasons we fight for voting rights and our democracy are self-evident and directly in front of us in the news. Other days we are reminded why we work so hard by a kind word or a shared moment. It's in that spirit that we share this quote from Martin Sheen:
"We are rightly challenged to find something in our lives worth fighting for. Something deeply personal and uncompromising. Something that can unite the will of the spirit with the work of the flesh. And when we find that we will discover fire for the second time. And then we will be able to help lift up this nation and all its people to that place where the heart is without fear and the head is held high.
Where knowledge is free, where the world has not been broken up into fragments by narrow, domestic walls. Where words come out from the depths of truth and tireless, striving, stretch our arms towards perfection. Where the clear stream of reason has not lost its way into the dreary desert sands of dead habit. Where the mind is led forward by thee into ever-widening thought and action.
Into that heaven of freedom, dear father, let our country awake."
Mr. Sheen was channeling President Bartlet, speaking at an event honoring the TV show The West Wing , but that shouldn't take anything away from his words. All our work to defend voting rights, to register new or lapsed voters, all the work to turn out voters in this crucial elections -- it's all because we've found this work defending democracy something deeply personal and uncompromising.
Team: You're standing with us because you agree. Please, we know we ask a lot, but if you can, chip in $25 or whatever you can to protect the right to vote and support our work to register and turn out voters across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Our democracy is worth fighting for. Our right to vote is sacred, fundamental, and the reason our country exists. The promise of America is the promise that we all matter, we all count, and all our voices are heard.
Help us make that promise a reality . The billionaires, the Super PACs, the lobbyists, the monied interests, none of them are making this work happen. You are, one donation at a time.
We only have a few weeks left, Team. Fuel our work with $25 or whatever you can right now to make every vote count and every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_3&amount=25]
Onward,
Mike

**Nella Domenici** is leading the charge for New Mexico Republicans to take back their state – and we need your help to get her elected. Nella is a fighter and will restore fresh, common-sense leadership back to Washington D.C.

Fellow Patriot,

**At West Point, we had a code: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.**

_First the New York Times lied about my childhood and family, and now CNN is lying about my business record._

And what's worse, they are doing it all because _I 'm within striking distance of an entrenched career politician, Bob Casey, in the #1 swing state in the nation that will determine control of the U.S Senate._

**Bob Casey is getting Leftist news sources to do his dirty work, and I WON 'T TOLERATE IT.

Here's the truth: this is a long message and I hope you will read all the way to the end.**

I grew up in Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania. We lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b3ddc20c041d44ee9e18e0e721d1803d&_e=tUnhGyYDtqR6BicLmBCdC4KmoMGJaT-qs1VpESed7T4ancRr7t_4pqcbyYIgIGMnPAGOjYYhEe6Lz-qa4pIGHJbezHsitMmssTC_Yv3Ss7KLrvA4k-4mboKOQZUuiynHZKm-Z3NT0nWQhkj36IQjkiWX6Nz-UOtDjQ4HOTM31EL_BdE-zfoNuLuX0m6YmaWjHgu-oCZTWhSLRA0_i7Ew6H0dnP9-RdQ2aTDdjCYvR2CU7CJV5Y6jt1CsDhvgs3YPSg_tUUNvnOhX7ryHasBo4PhZOJMn3dJwIx3kUExCC9u-V3ybIjMMAGGImoyRaCD-mZ1I_CQ66W_8ccih_CL6ts6DRFFgGsxgWh1210GxYYPG_U1V5XL8sNAx_Lj9KOqCskR2nAI25j2DA5QzVJxA1U1-clKDDfWPeMzkVXykoz8%3D)

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b3ddc20c041d44ee9e18e0e721d1803d&_e=tUnhGyYDtqR6BicLmBCdC4KmoMGJaT-qs1VpESed7T4ancRr7t_4pqcbyYIgIGMnPAGOjYYhEe6Lz-qa4pIGHJbezHsitMmssTC_Yv3Ss7KLrvA4k-4mboKOQZUuiynHZKm-Z3NT0nWQhkj36IQjkiWX6Nz-UOtDjQ4HOTM31EL_BdE-zfoNuLuX0m6YmaWjHgu-oCZTWhSLRA0_i7Ew6H0dnP9-RdQ2aTDdjCYvR2CU7CJV5Y6jt1CsDhvgs3YPSg_tUUNvnOhX7ryHasBo4KVCo4Q2bS6rQ2zWu8ShPPNWtBLZd7t_tfE-il-fZ6Zl_vJGYYm59eHJX4noTV68jEIlopEq-NpLIgNbenkRaZeskEurXiGyuY-ZCqNmyFb-PlmK2t1muvQ_RsZ_q4-S9DoILFpVB9JKo_op9bE59xQ%3D)

After the Army, I earned a Ph.D. in international relations before moving to Pittsburgh to start a career in business. I worked my way up to become the CEO of FreeMarkets, a successful tech startup that employed hundreds in Western Pennsylvania.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b3ddc20c041d44ee9e18e0e721d1803d&_e=tUnhGyYDtqR6BicLmBCdC4KmoMGJaT-qs1VpESed7T4ancRr7t_4pqcbyYIgIGMnPAGOjYYhEe6Lz-qa4pIGHJbezHsitMmssTC_Yv3Ss7KLrvA4k-4mboKOQZUuiynHZKm-Z3NT0nWQhkj36IQjkiWX6Nz-UOtDjQ4HOTM31EL_BdE-zfoNuLuX0m6YmaWjHgu-oCZTWhSLRA0_i7Ew6H0dnP9-RdQ2aTDdjCYvR2CU7CJV5Y6jt1CsDhvgs3YPSg_tUUNvnOhX7ryHasBo4FupI0jba3eavu7EhsAYmZqwTpLgXv-53M5yQ3qWgvAX7xKYOR5L-HdqNRAN3Vq6SY6SbARXAJkUvjiElXBhyCoQ6OjWz2-RKzRqHyuWnTW_LqhK_UqX2d4-ez_2Q2ZcqHUcXwpJ8-kpOJr9QZL7B7c%3D)

I was then called to service again, this time in the highest levels of government as Under Secretary of Treasury and as Deputy National Security Advisor.

Following this, I joined Bridgewater Associates, one of the largest, most successful investment firms in the world, which manages the pension plans of groups including teachers, firefighters and law enforcement.

I have lived the American Dream, and I am running for Senate to bring my decades of experience and love for our country to fix our broken economy that is a direct result of policies supported by my opponent, who has spent 18 years in Washington with NOTHING to show for it.

_**I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it 's sad to see we've fallen so far that these media outlets like the New York Times and CNN are pushing the Democrats' baked narrative about my upbringing and my business record.**_

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b3ddc20c041d44ee9e18e0e721d1803d&_e=tUnhGyYDtqR6BicLmBCdC4KmoMGJaT-qs1VpESed7T4ancRr7t_4pqcbyYIgIGMnPAGOjYYhEe6Lz-qa4pIGHJbezHsitMmssTC_Yv3Ss7KLrvA4k-4mboKOQZUuiynHZKm-Z3NT0nWQhkj36IQjkiWX6Nz-UOtDjQ4HOTM31EL_BdE-zfoNuLuX0m6YmaWjHgu-oCZTWhSLRA0_i7Ew6H0dnP9-RdQ2aTDdjCYvR2CU7CJV5Y6jt1CsDhvgs3YPSg_tUUNvnOhX7ryHasBo4OKd3T9C20iwE9U-f9THSUgMKYgaZdYzVECL1Sqbb07geq8acHYgEyuG5kGBnrBYqMMrYBZcpF_JW2WqYEWgvLFzRmYApSrG31oD6pALqLU4jryisQ1fYGTRbGSQQcM64_zLfGB9H1gyhbefOx-OUCE%3D)

I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and **if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it!**

Here's where I need your help, Fellow Patriot. **We need to combat these lies with the TRUTH about me.** The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know if Kamala Harris and Bob Casey lose Pennsylvania, they lose it ALL, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me.

body:
Colin Allred is gaining momentum and closing the gap | | | Hey, Peter. David McIntosh here from Club for Growth Action. I’m reaching out to you with an urgent request. For years, Ted Cruz has been an economic defender we can count on. He’s voted in favor of tax cuts, has championed small businesses, and stood firm in support of free market policies that drive American prosperity. But he’s facing a tough race, Peter. Colin Allred is gaining momentum and closing the gap. body:
Peter, Cecile Richards here, former president of the Planned Parenthood Action Fund.
[**I’m reaching out to personally ask for your support for Bob Casey’s re-election campaign.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241017-7?recurring=1&refcode=em20241017-7&refcode2=4598_552475_1G5FT6&akid=4598%2E552475%2E1G5FT6)
Since the overturning of Roe v. Wade two years ago, Republican-led state legislatures have banned abortion, hospitals have denied pregnant patients lifesaving care, and women have been forced to travel hundreds of miles to access abortion.
Unless we do everything we can between now and Election Day, this could be just the beginning. If Republicans take back the Senate and win the White House this November, **they will ban abortion nationwide.**
Our best chance to repair the damage done to reproductive freedom is to keep the Senate and the White House in Democratic hands, and **Pennsylvania is the linchpin in that fight.**
That’s why I’m emailing you today, Peter. Bob Casey has fought tirelessly for Pennsylvanians during his time in the Senate. He is a champion for women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights. And he’s up against David McCormick, an anti-abortion extremist who called the overturning of Roe a “huge victory” and supports an abortion ban with no exceptions for rape or incest.
[**Please, will you join me in supporting Bob Casey by chipping in any amount today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241017-7?recurring=1&refcode=em20241017-7&refcode2=4598_552475_1G5FT6&akid=4598%2E552475%2E1G5FT6)

A lot has happened since this time last week. So today, I wanted to give you a quick update on the latest news in Missouri's U.S. Senate race:
**LAST THURSDAY -- **After 55 days without holding even one public campaign event, Josh Hawley slummed it back to Missouri for a one-day tour of the state on a multi-million dollar private jet with KC kicker Harrison Butker.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**FRIDAY -- **The joint appearance Josh Hawley and Harrison Butker made live on Fox News the night before started to go viral. It won't take you long to figure out why...
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4ef9dc16-2a36-48a3-b4fc-68c1d793edbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**SATURDAY --** Butker announced a new PAC he started to support Josh Hawley over the final stretch of this election. This is just the latest example of Hawley's radical elite supporters banding together to bail out his campaign.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**SUNDAY -- **The biggest newspaper in our state, the St. Louis Post-Dispatch, officially endorsed my campaign -- with a damning rejection of Hawley's extremism and failure to deliver for Missouri in any capacity during his six years in the Senate.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**MONDAY --** Hawley kicked off a "bus tour" that probably looks more like...
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**TUESDAY --** All of our fundraising numbers from July through September were submitted to the Federal Election Commission and we learned that our campaign outraised Josh Hawley's AGAIN. By a lot. This is how his campaign responded:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**WEDNESDAY --** That train kept rolling with bad headlines about Josh Hawley getting published left and right, about his use of private flights and even his ties to Project 2025.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**TODAY --** We learned Josh Hawley's bus tour wrapped up after just three days. And then, while he traveled back to wherever he came from, his campaign bus was caught parked illegally in St. Louis County.
The plus side? Hawley paying those parking tickets might end up being the first time he's brought money back to Missouri since he got to the U.S. Senate!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**TOMORROW --** Our campaign is holding a big rally with born-and-raised Missourian Andy Cohen and the Missouri Fire Fighters in St. Louis City! **[Click here to learn more.](https://substack.com/redirect/a6a8ba30-7130-46d3-ab77-e7d43bec9fca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a6a8ba30-7130-46d3-ab77-e7d43bec9fca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We've hit the campaign trail hard these last few weeks. And over the 19 days ahead, I'm ready to do everything it'll take to defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for real Missourians -- like holding big rallies, keeping our ads on TV, and continuing to meet with voters of all parties, all across the state of Missouri.
In a race this close, just about anything could tip the scales. That's why I'm asking:
**[Will you help me ramp up every aspect of our campaign over the coming days and weeks by chipping in $15 or whatever you can today? ](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/247c47be-8382-4972-b1c0-5b7ad869e056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We've never had a better opportunity to defeat Josh Hawley or flip Missouri's U.S. Senate seat -- and in the final days of this race, I'm counting on your help now more than ever.
Thank you,
-- Lucas

Peter, I have a big favor to ask:
Will you make a split donation of $12 (the price of one of my signature flattop haircuts) to help us reach 50,000 grassroots donations before our midnight deadline? Montana’s Senate race will be won by a handful of votes, and my team needs even more resources to stand up to the millions of dollars outside groups are throwing my way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241017em-12-RS]
DONATE $12 → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241017em-12-RS&amount=12]
DONATE OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241017em-12-RS]
Thousands of folks have chipped in since we launched this campaign. And whether you’ve given $5, $50, or $500, I couldn’t be more grateful to have your support. Your donation helps us show pundits and my opponent that we have grassroots momentum on our side.
Trust me, I know how far a few bucks can go: My flattop haircut costs just $12.
In all seriousness, we’ve got our work cut for us. Outside groups are spending up a storm to defeat me. My multimillionaire opponent has already cut his campaign $2.4 million from his own wallet. And virtually every election expert ranks this race a toss-up.
It would mean a lot to have your support in this race, because every donation goes a long way. Even $12.
So, will you split $12 or more to help us reach our goal so I can bring this race home? We’ve got less than 100 days until the election, so let’s get it done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241017em-12-RS]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-tester?refcode=241017em-12-RS]
Thanks for your support.
—Jon Tester

body:
|
#
---
_Aloha Peter, this is Mazie. I wanted to pass along this message from Colin Allred. He is running for Senate in Texas to unseat Ted Cruz and expand our majority. Please take a moment to read his message and**[chip in](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95257777/506148496/484726470?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241017_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTgxYzQ0ZC1lYzhjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fZ-74sUWbPh2ALrHeuRFF9hTRFQlQ5Nkkkap5iZhSvE=)** , if you can._
* * *
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95257778/506148497/484726470?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241017_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTgxYzQ0ZC1lYzhjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fZ-74sUWbPh2ALrHeuRFF9hTRFQlQ5Nkkkap5iZhSvE=) Peter, this week on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6. And what was his response? _He laughed!!_ There's nothing funny about this, Peter. I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol. First, I heard the glass break. **Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son:_"Whatever happens, I love you."_** I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that. **But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – _hid in a supply closet._** In just 19 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve. clean_body: My note: California is key | | = Let me tell you the truth: I’m running for Senate because I want to get things done for all Californians. But I also truly believe that our democracy is in trouble. In the last eight years, we have seen things take place in this country that I never would have imagined in America — an attempted insurrection, the GOP devolving into a destructive cult of personality around the deeply immoral figure of Donald Trump, and some of our most precious freedoms stripped away by a Supreme Court packed with partisan and reactionary justices. I can’t and won’t promise that there’s a magic wand where we can fix this all overnight. But I remain optimistic about our future, and know that we CAN make real progress in protecting our democracy. = = = = = = What would you do if you knew your donation today would help Democrats win control of the U.S. House? Well, it’s no joke. Election analysts, forecasters, pundits, the media, and even Republicans have all come to the same conclusion: The U.S. House is going to be decided here in California. It’s why National Republicans have invested more than $6.4 million in House races across the state. And it’s why I’m focused on flipping SIX House seats in California from red to blue. That’s why I am emailing you a very important request to help the California Democratic Party flip those seats. = = With your help, next year I will be working in the U.S. Senate alongside a Democratic House Majority — after watching the speaker’s gavel pass from Mike Johnson to Hakeem Jeffries — so we can protect our democracy, and achieve progress for everyday Americans. Let’s do this! \- Adam | | = Our Democratic leaders are working hard to make California a better place to live. subject: I just got off MSNBC. I need your help. Right now.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:

> _**" The gift you carry for others is not an attempt to save the world but to fully belong to it. It's not possible to save the world by trying to save it. You need to find what is genuinely yours to offer the world before you can make it a better place. Discovering your unique gift to bring to your community is your greatest opportunity, and challenge. The offering of that gift -- your true self -- is the most you can do to love and serve the world. And it is all the world needs.**_
> _**Vocation does not come from willfulness. It comes from listening ...That insight is hidden in the word vocation itself, which is rooted in the Latin for "voice." **_
> _**Vocation does not mean a goal I pursue. It means a calling that I hear ...I must listen for the truths and values at the heart of my own identity. **_
> _**Today I understand vocation ...not as a goal to be achieved, but as a gift to be received. Discovering vocation does not mean scrambling toward some prize just beyond my reach but accepting the treasure of true self I already possess. Vocation does not come from a voice 'out there' calling me to become something I am not. It comes from a voice 'in here' calling me to be the person I was born to be, to fulfill the original selfhood given me at birth by God.**_
> _**One sign that something is your vocation is that you would do it for free, even if there is no reward or social payoff. That clarifies a vocation quite quickly ..."**_
_~ from Richard Rohr 's contemplative prayer: daily meditations ~_

In Iraq, I had my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. I’ll fight it out on my own if I have to, but I’m not afraid to ask for help when I need it.

Team — Ruben. Personal note from me today, before tonight’s deadline.

It’s hard to shake the feeling that something’s wrong.

I’m not sure what it is, but you can always tell when something bad’s going to happen. I’ve got to tell you — right now, it feels like something’s off. I keep hearing about how this Senate race is locked up, that Kari Lake’s as good as defeated. I’m not seeing that.

You can’t escape the attack ads out here. Every time you turn on the TV they’re on. Trump’s got his eyes firmly fixed on Arizona, and Elon Musk is spending millions of his own money on get-out-the-vote efforts here. Kari Lake is still a threat, and don’t forget — she only lost by a few thousand votes last time.

And at the same time, our own fundraising... it’s not good. Without giving too much away here, we’re looking at big cuts because we’re not pulling in as much as we hoped we would. All of that adds up.

Marines have an old motto: “First to Fight.” In Iraq, we’d use special knocks to identify friend from foe when we were surrounded by insurgents. The comfort was knowing your friends were with you, that you had each other’s back. [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54969?t=7&akid=22331%2E4449941%2EbNJgFr) **In Iraq, I had my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. I’ll fight it out on my own if I have to, but I’m not afraid to ask for help when I need it.**

My team is facing a critical deadline coming up tonight, I’m knocking. I need your help. Please. [**Can I count on you to make a split donation ($10, or anything, really) with Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats before tonight’s deadline? We’ve got to keep the pressure on. name: The Federalist Wire
subject: Victor Davis Hanson: Dueling Populisms
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Dear Friend,

Populism is a word often used to describe emerging political
trends around the world. But populism isn't just a modern
phenomenon - it goes back centuries.

Traditionally described as a battle between Left and Right,
political differences are actually far more complex. What we are
witnessing today are two distinct populist movements challenging
party establishments across the West. Remarkably, these tensions
can be traced all the way back to Roman times.

This is why I'm reaching out to you today. I want to offer you
a free copy of one of our most insightful eBooks: Dueling
Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson. Hanson, a Hoover Senior Fellow
and acclaimed historian, provides a unique perspective that I
believe you'll find incredibly valuable.

In Dueling Populisms you'll discover:

What to expect from a political landscape dominated by
movements that oppose both the establishment and each other.

The striking similarities between ancient populist
movements and today's progressive and conservative populisms.

Insights into what the future holds for America as we
navigate these revived ancient tensions in our modern culture.

This eBook is especially relevant as we face increasing
political polarization and try to anticipate and understand
election outcomes. By understanding the historical context of
these populist movements, you'll gain a clearer view of our
current environment and the potential paths forward. Hanson's
expertise will help you see beyond the surface of today's
political debates and grasp the deeper currents at play.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to deepen your understanding
of today's political dynamics. Get your free copy of Dueling
Populisms using this secure link: Get Your Free eBook

I hope that it helps equip you to understand and participate in
the civic discourse in the coming months.

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development

Hoover Institution | Stanford University

With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and
Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven
policy research organization that seeks to improve the human
condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity,
national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one
hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that
have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

subject: The Patriotic Roadmap I Wrote for You
body:

We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans,
it's a question of how we reset
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW3ub9PW4N

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

body:
You deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/PS_80U54yPFGONYt2mribg~~/AARclAA~~)

Friend,

If you watched the second debate, you heard a lot of “career politician talk” from my opponent Bob Casey.

He lied about me, he lied about his record, and he refused to take responsibility for the failures he and the rest of the DC liberals have caused to our economy and at the border.

**On Day One in the Army, you learn to take responsibility for your actions, but Bob Casey is a typical career politician. He takes zero responsibility. **

At one point he even had the nerve to lecture me about the conflict in the Middle East. _I went to West Point, Ranger School, and was a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War and received a Bronze Star for my service._

**I 'm not going to be lectured by a guy who has spent 30 years in elected office with NOTHING to show for it but a weak voting record that lines up 99% of the time with Biden/Harris.**

name: Kimberly Carris
subject: Our Family is Fighting For You: Help Us Build a Better Future
body:
Peter,At different times in life, we are called to serve, and my husband, Jim Carris, has answered that call. **I know in my heart that he is the leader we need in Congress to represent Illinois ' 10th District.**Running for office wasn't an easy decision. Jim stepped away from a successful career, but after seeing the challenges our own children face--one in middle school, one in high school, and one in college--we knew we couldn't wait any longer. **Like many families in our district, we 've felt the same struggles--juggling bills, worrying about our children's futures, and dealing with the rising cost of living.**After much thought, Jim and I feel strongly that right now is the time for him to do this. Jim has spent his life building a career as a business leader, an attorney, a father and husband, and, just as importantly, as the son of an immigrant who taught him the value of hard work and opportunity. **The reason that I know Jim is ready for this role is that he has deep knowledge of many of the sectors that affect our country 's policies, a hunger to learn from others, an incredible work ethic, and a strong sense of pride and gratitude for our country.** Jim has always been committed to building a better future. As the son of an immigrant, he worked his way through college and law school, and he's spent his career helping others succeed. **Now, he wants to fight for families across our district so that every child has the opportunities they deserve.****[Will you contribute $25 right now to help us get Jim 's message out across the District?](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-r/)**We can't afford more of the same policies that have left our children worse off. Jim will be the voice we need in Washington, standing up for our families and fighting for a brighter future.But we can't do it alone. **Please consider donating $25 today to help Jim bring real change to our community.** [PLEASE DONATE $25 TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-y/) Thank you,_Kimberly Carris_ Proud Wife and Partner of Jim Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-j/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-i/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-d/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-fb-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-h/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-tw-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-k/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-li-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-u/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-sjtydyd-l-o) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-u-sjtydyd-tlidtddjku-m/)

## Israeli Forces Kill Hamas Leader Sinwar
Israeli forces [killed top Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OpiAUxvGr0Q4DB_wqKLaxe7fd0hzhoOyiGGA1ztVP3kmmnO6f_Jonz5_X_EIf_LH-xp10cXFGU_xFs-BMDAzUrGqrHRGQrEmLHkZoheRQb9qMYuhG6I2S5Lpu6Em2wEkNbjHKtq72GjgowcUgOB-kaMQiuTS2JVROAm8rxcn6ElPzN_qjbOTCEy9KjYl7HfRWypkr-auCqYLpvu_mWMxBd357BdM73xBTsBVMwV_ElhDX7_5_WiyU2YY7ZhYILSX24PYgy_64MbEz5uyX8LB_PgSybMUPZMkcKPp2BKiTtuftQ_C56yvF1x19-BpXfvjq0vAZAAD__19JbWU)on Thursday, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed.Sinwar died in Rafah after an Israeli tank shell collapsed a building during a routine patrol that encountered Hamas terrorists.Although the operation wasn't specifically targeting him, Sinwar was found in the rubble, wearing a bulletproof vest and surrounded by grenades. A key figure behind the Oct. 7 terror attacks, Sinwar had been on the run for weeks. His death has drawn [global reactions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFytSAQRp8GOxxY4FcLir-xu2lTOoRdr5tBuINEJ2-fMX3a72vOOe-P5RE4cX6-hZ18W8sSYuOTFq2kHiXYxXboVyIg05HXA0zgtFHQbT6iGt3k1tGqAVWcnIt6ikMcLaF1qDv2oMBqpUet1Gh0rz-MMhEdBbsaUE5YRcit1P6zcG4brem7nFT7WPYu-a211yHMfwGzgPm6rr7SV6N63P-9lJpQwLwzYiJJ4WgCZs6Nag6NSw5JVrqFSpZIoW1yC3s4ZKKAVOXB-QpV3pDy9h0EzF31-Lo4JT7-DcKq5x44_fK0P_KcHn4CAAD__6bqZ4s), with U.S. officials calling it a major victory and a potential turning point in the Gaza conflict.
## Treasury: AI Saved Billions in Fraud
The U.S. Treasury Department’s new AI-powered fraud detection system [prevented or helped recover](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGynSAQgOGnwQ6HBfRoQZHG7qZN6ay46GYQHcBjzttnkv7Wf_PP9-tr_kKOnLafeJCr4ZzRV37TDErCILWdbbO6QKTJNOTgpUfdgVG62Z1ZCDz0I3ry1A8LWkVgbRfCMPZgqWGnlbagYAClBgMtLEYZv3aENhitOmEVrVzP3P4-OdWdQvycb8qtP48mur3WqwjzQ-hJ6Ol5njYtPtFT_nWhp-UunKgUoSd_pnIflIWe9vORyBJz5cCeMUpOlWLkjZInGXjba5EV_1z4oSxDxnuVNROWO3_kSleV2SeEVzdC32S3Xg_HyKV_Cau2Azn-36vfaL2d_hsAAP__ScFvsA) more than $4 billion in taxpayer money over the past year.Check fraud in the U.S. has increased by 385% since the COVID-19 pandemic, with total online payment fraud predicted to [exceed $362 billion by 2028](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn8NbERwYMceGLp4S9eOFoYjvgobi1xc5d9X6d7x-97wpPd1m2-BCu33z7Ch51znEJlOnI1WZlDgZieTz4iAVqI3VxihM1aDXP2Ye9v3YHIwOXULBMgIIeqlW5ZBpyjJgwZntBmM1oM1F7NYbWPqMLhsQXfCaUzEtV2-K-28Yi6vemK7xLrJ4lfm4yHsh4BJwMQrrlTKmwmYjloovt43xnWvpd7fw412dKZT3DA8nu2lEh6h8YY7q0Aqt_BM6mh44s5UdwGTbD4dP1QKPfqrcPq-BfpzSP4nx-nhNwAA___GO2NX). Treasury has joined the IRS in using AI to identify and address fraud and noncompliance.A Treasury spokesperson refused to provide specific examples of how AI is being deployed to stop fraud, but the department plans to share its techniques with other federal agencies.
## Musical Star Mitzi Gaynor Dead at 93
Singer, dancer, and [actress Mitzi Gaynor](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jzFv8yAUAH8NbFjwgAQPDN_iLd_a0SLwiF-FTWSorfTXV-ne7aQbTvdxm2-BCm2P_2FF33OdQ-x04KykUE6AmQ1PPiMCao5eXWEEq7QEvvgRzGV01minor1eYnbK6OTcPVkncx45eZBglFROSem0GtRdSx2TxWCyBmmZkZio1334rLT1BXN51QP3IdaVF7_0_mxM_2MwMZjO8xzivW14trdnML2RwbRS_ybxCK-t7iJhSKLVr76IZ4iUKYrWw85g4rtPz5NKoXa5MiMfa6DyW-p_jB8efgIAAP__lbhauQ), who wowed audiences in movies, on television, and in Las Vegas, died Thursday. She was 93. Her most famous role was as Navy nurse Nellie Forbush in _South Pacific_ , in which she memorably sang "I’m Gonna Wash That Man Right Outa My Hair" and "Some Enchanted Evening." [You can see a musical montage here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jzFvszAQQH-NvQWd7-wAg4dP-cSWql3aERl8Do5MnBIDyr-v0r3re9KT3te5P7uY4u3y5ma2JeTejSVu3Cs4qOaAutfS28CMTJKtqrFFowhQTtbXzgMZw80QYFRomkBwbEFB3YYWnYwWAbUC1SiAhlSlBgIavWGnAyEYoYF9LHmprjneysQhPfPGSzXmWSY7lXJ_CPonsBPY7ftePfNa1oFf_kVcGSdB3Sbo__Ub1o8Tvn-eslysv-8xpfg41kLDZXYx_SbLH4ebxZ8AAAD__5GEUZI) Born Francesca Marlene de Czanyi von Gerber in Chicago in 1931, Gaynor trained as a ballerina before moving to Hollywood and enjoying a career as a professional entertainer for eight decades. [Here are photos of her life.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71yqzAQQOGngU6e_RE2LlTcxp1vm5JZpMVsRlgMKGScp88kfepTnPne7sNdLNvz8V8WDXUqg8Rqhw4IDntHfvBtCpMqKbca8EJX6pCB2jn0MkKXlCNez4lH9Eg8igKOmLyIthYIyCNgjwA94wlHBo6pU_ETE3SNB01Wy3Z6L_ass075VQ7dTrEsbQ5zreve8L-Gbg3dVi1r1p_U0G2x-mXuIa9n2VxSSW4vH3V2q0SbLLq9yub6MzEytltI66flbPv50nh4LGL5d1H_EB-BvgMAAP__vK5YXQ)Gaynor’s husband and manager, Jack Bean, died in 2006. [They married in 1954](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO2zAQBNCvobo1yKVk04UKB4G6S5MiQBqDEpfW5iTSIPdMOF8fnMsAVw0GU8379XZ987xxuv3wO40S89Uvwg-6Gg3GAfbXvgtjJEKyHY3mhGccjNXYraMOeHR2Nid0c3Ru0H3UOJj55GKgsx06HlFjb7RxRmtnzcHMVtslDOT7aFEPqtcUWHI5_MmcZKW4PfODymHJe7eNq8i9KntROCmcWmuHvabPTeFECT7qK4WKeE47Jfm_w0IbzYXlqXDaWf4y3Pwz5QI1f8gKd79w5AWq-AJtzdByeacAjWWFWHx6h8rJS_HgU4CZ0w2Wkuv8hEA-gBc4W4WTL3C5mFqP7reyU144KPv926cqtfqTyr0rY7g33jaux5Pq9W33vL1eyhfojxH_BQAA___n2Ids) and had no children.

name: Jon Tester
subject: grounded.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, folks? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/82338?t=6&akid=17536%2E878179%2ExwewtJ) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.

[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help me keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/82338?t=7&akid=17536%2E878179%2ExwewtJ)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/82339?t=8&akid=17536%2E878179%2ExwewtJ)
---

[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/82342?t=11&akid=17536%2E878179%2ExwewtJ)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/82343?t=12&akid=17536%2E878179%2ExwewtJ)
I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.

— Jon

## Judge Stops Execution in "Shaken Baby" Case
Thursday's scheduled execution of Robert Roberson was halted in the final 90 minutes by Travis County District Judge Jessica Mangrum, who [granted a temporary restraining order](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00bGSpCAQxvGnwawtGhElMLjEbC-9cAqadqUOYUq4cXz7q918X-BX31f_Px-PDxdTzJ-_3cFLe2_loaTSgBJwfgQX0_3QXVi8DBY7XnBSVmmrJtvty4jsFY5ykPNmkEib0UpviEkPyk1jF5cvDCXOiBJx6g352U0WLSHrYdiElhxiK2ffdm78dnVLd3nx2VM5urTsrT2rGH4JtQq1XtfVk69o-_YSanVni5RYqDXzVYVaUyGXhFrZ1QbfGhwug2cqB1fY4lkbPPmsJUMr4Bn4zfSvcYC6u7-cwTt_Q71zOMvBENi1HajkV6QWS4bA9RkbAyUXjwplg5hzIc70tWKUCMbLoPQcYPTWgDY4whyMBmMl2VltxgfdnUt4XjGlWM0ktPw8XEzfh9uPBV6L-h8AAP__Cp6Ihg). Roberson, convicted in 2003 for the death of his 2-year-old daughter on a controversial "shaken baby" diagnosis, was saved by a subpoena Wednesday issued by the Texas House Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence. [The subpoena ](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ8GOkfeNWBcuPibdPnbK9HaXgfrDETYl4S3P5H-ytFoRp--r9t0o5TTev9PC9v6jtuEEjsBUsA4BUr5mLo2WCeDgZYtaDTYGdSmna1DJAdjz9o5iuQ0DWpUhIEY1aBjm-x5BhJGAAmgL4N3I2kDxgN3SsWmkxxS3fZLnbnym0rMx_bk_eK3pc12rvVRGvWvwWuDV3qs_CpndYa9Jp-5wetnJ_jN_qembRVlpm9ehSN3iHKsYd8WFsDRGC979B4GJfXYk-_DwMgheuNdu9vweKWcUxl008n7Qil_KOqfWp4WfwMAAP__Rf5lTg)required Roberson to appear in the state House on Monday to discuss his case. The judge concluded the state's authority to execute Roberson doesn't override the subpoena. The U.S. Supreme Court on Thursday declined to stay the execution, but the temporary restraining order has postponed it. Attorney General Ken Paxton is [expected to appeal the ruling](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ8Gd7bYNQG7oLiGLtdeaWFYEiRsIiBx8van5E_7V6OZkT6N5t95OduY4n75azfS7RnyghxFD7yHafE2ptciOq9X7mfoSIPCGcWMau6u2gFJlH6dHEer5CRUGNUkIZxmHzzKLuo3DDhMABxADdKtk1UzzA5IjGNggpOPLZehXanR09aQXvlBZXB565K-tnarbPzD0DA0x3EM--p8ON41Q7PTURmalJ1NDM0H0H_Der8V2qh3-V5a72NtJbr2ta3kvuSVSvuRmveenuTuLeadoRmlEjidGJquaH87YkqxSsUEv2w2ps-69utdD43_AwAA__8SD243) and the outcome could change overnight.
## Disaster Declared in Laredo E. Coli Crisis
Texas Governor Greg Abbott [declared a state of disaster](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOqzAQheGnMd0gz8QEXLi4DV1uuyWy8UCsdeIITyB5-1W23-aUn47-r8t08Smn-_rf39jJaykTaTKAGnCYok_5PZkmuqCjxYYd9mTJWOptc3U6dnZZFjMsxugQkNjOQXed0Uyd5a5J7oOhxgFRI_bteQ6D7y3aGdmcTosymmOSsrVyZeGXr0t-l523di63JruryKOq0z9Fo6LxOI72e73XVnZF44dWNKL-zFnRuJYd1o1X8CEUEYg8Z79xhSpeGGKqvgpvcHAIMJfnXd4QnwyPUpOknYFhLjmBcJWqaGw2Fx9HyjnVc6-MXm8-5d9j8mep3dFPAAAA___kQmtM) in Webb County after E. coli was detected in Laredo's water system. The declaration mobilizes state resources and permits regulatory suspensions to facilitate a faster emergency response. It also allows city officials to [request federal assistance](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-N2Yx8xsF48NCFLV07osM-gqUjpsYNyb-v0r3rp09PT-_rOl0xcbrfPnEjX59LnrTSRoKSMEwRE78m00Q_q-igIQ9WO22ctq5ZvbbBdKG_OIiX2eiAi7M9Qo8BLMWLbZJ_w0DBAKAAbNuHeUDrwAUg03WLMIpiqrm0daVKTzwWfuUHlTbkrWG_1rofovsQehR6PM-z5a3mO6c7vR9Cj5wDstAjlpoC03vBQjHLEysVSSFzkjXQtzx-9p1fcsZQqSSUiZluyBLcYDpQ0O7r3hQf9zMxp6O3wqjbhon_XOq_cR5e_wYAAP__bAxnyA). The contamination prompted a [citywide boil water advisory](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQhX-N2Yx8BwU8eOjiLV07ogOfE6smjvApJP--onuXp_eWT0_f92W-UMrpfv2ijZ28YpnRYK_BaJjmQCm_574JbjHBQsMORrTYWxxtc3NTGJDMx9BFu8CEIQ4E0UYLS5zGELlJ7oSBgQnAAIztsC4TjRbsCtx3XVS94ZCk7K3cWPhFNeZ3efLermVrsruJPKrqPhV6hf44jvbneq-tPBX6E63QgzkDFPpMO4eiA69nq7oKCeuQKlXhXdOWgl5Kyvqgc9-LpJUV-mZ34XGknFMdRtWb60Yp_x2Qf408Hf4GAAD__0KAYpU) last week. The city set up water distribution points, and Mayor Victor Trevino has prioritized close collaboration with the state to protect public health.
## Nearly 30% of Border Cameras Not Working

body:
Election volunteer, age 70, hospitalized following assault, others report sign theft, vandalism
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
LAST CALL FOR TICKETS to the **Grand Junction Rocky Mountain Rumble** this Sunday from 4-6pm in Clifton, CO! [Click here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (or keep scrolling) to read more about the awesome slate of speakers and, while tickets are free, you must reserve your spot [HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Hope to see all of my Western Slope friends there :)
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, October 18, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Election volunteer, age 70, hospitalized following assault, others report sign theft, vandalism](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The political battleground in Colorado isn’t simply limited to choices on the ballot._
_Volunteers are finding the streets to be more than just a figurative battleground, as despite their efforts to promote a better tomorrow they are literally under attack today._
_As Colorado’s election season heats up, a disturbing trend is emerging — campaign materials being stolen or vandalized and, worse, violence targeting campaign volunteers._
_In a region spanning Colorado Senate District 12, House Districts 16 and 17 and other areas, the tension surrounding local Republican campaigns is manifesting in dangerous ways._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[RSVP FOR FREE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Rocky Mountain Rumble is Sunday in Clifton, limited tickets are still available to attend](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Heidi Ganahl, the co-founder of Rocky Mountain Voice, will be joined by Colorado House Minority Leader Rose Pugliese and other conservative leaders during the Rocky Mountain Rumble and “Get Out The Vote” event on the Western Slope.
* The Rocky Mountain Rumble will take place from 4-6 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 20, at the Clifton Community Center, 3270 D 1/2 Road in Clifton. The event is free to attend, but tickets are required.
* The event will have a pure Western Slope flavor. Commissioners Cody Davis and Bobbie Daniel from Mesa County, where the event is taking place, will be joined by state Sen. Janice Rich of Mesa County, state Senate District 5 candidate and House District 58 Rep. Marc Catlin of Montrose County, Mesa County School Board President Andrea Haitz, and “Halt the Dolores” leader Sean Pond.
* Limited tickets for the Rocky Mountain Rumble are still available. [Click here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to RSVP to the Rumble.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Durango School Board pauses decision to ban LGBTQ+, Black Lives Matter flags in classrooms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Durango School Board held a meeting on October 15 to discuss the district's recent decision to remove LGBTQ+ Pride and Black Lives Matter flags from classrooms after a parent complained that these flags promoted political agendas.
* The decision sparked community outrage, with many teachers, students, and community members expressing their concerns during the emotionally charged meeting.
* Some attendees, like teacher Joanne Spudman and student Ava Allen, argued that the removal of the flags diminishes safe spaces for marginalized students, while a parent supporting the flag ban argued that schools should be a place for learning, not indoctrination.
* Board members acknowledged the complexity of balancing legal, financial, and community responsibilities, and voted to suspend the implementation of the flag ban until further legal review.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ex-ICE official John Fabbricatore warns Tren de Aragua growing faster than MS-13](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former ICE field director John Fabbricatore warned that the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua (TdA) is more organized and structured than MS-13, posing a growing threat across the U.S., including in states like Georgia, Colorado, and New York.
* Fabbricatore, who is now a GOP congressional candidate, emphasized that TdA has rapidly expanded and embedded itself in U.S. communities, particularly in Aurora, Colorado, where apartment blocks have been taken over by the gang.
* Former President Trump announced "Operation Aurora" to dismantle illegal migrant criminal networks, including TdA, if re-elected, using the Alien Enemies Act of 1798.
* Fabbricatore supports Trump’s plan, emphasizing the need to act swiftly to protect U.S. citizens.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fundraising for Colorado’s ballot measures picks up with less than three weeks before Election Day](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Fundraising for Colorado's ballot measures is intensifying with less than three weeks before Election Day, with groups gearing up for a final spending push.
* Proposition 131, which aims to introduce ranked-choice voting and open primaries, is leading fundraising efforts, with Colorado Voters First raising over $10.8 million to back it.
* Amendment 79, which seeks to enshrine abortion rights in the Colorado Constitution, has raised $8.5 million, with opposition groups raising significantly less.
* Proposition 127, which would ban the hunting of certain wildcats, has raised close to $3 million, with opposition groups raising $1.6 million.
* Several other measures, including Proposition 129 (veterinary care), Amendment 80 (school choice), and Proposition KK (crime victim services), have also seen substantial fundraising efforts ahead of the election.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Momentum shifts against Kamala Harris, in favor of Donald Trump with 19 days until election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Momentum has shifted in favor of Donald Trump with less than three weeks until Election Day, particularly in key battleground states.
* Polls show tightening races in swing states like Wisconsin, Michigan, and Pennsylvania, where Kamala Harris has lost her lead or is now tied with Trump.
* Democratic strategists express concern over the trend, with some calling the situation "terrifying," while the Harris campaign dismisses the significance of these polls.
* Trump’s campaign is reportedly gaining strength, but GOP strategists caution that challenges remain, including media bias and Democratic swing state governors. Republicans are calling for volunteers to help secure election integrity and mobilize voter turnout for Trump.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Caldara: State power weaponized against out-of-favor gay group](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JON CALDARA, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Being gay but not holding a liberal opinion makes you a hate group._
_It’s fine to be part of the LGBTQIA+ crowd in Colorado. In fact, you’ll be celebrated, and, if you wish, officially honored with a flag that has flown over the Capitol._
_However, if you’re part of the LGBTQIA+ community but don’t believe small children should be indoctrinated into thinking they were born to the wrong gender, well then, you’re a hater and must be canceled. So says our state government._
_According to the state of Colorado, only straights can be against indoctrinating little children to want to mutilate their bodies._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**Support Amendment 80: Constitutional right to school choice**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | STATE | OCTOBER 4** _Shall there be an amendment to the Colorado Constitution establishing the right to school choice for children in kindergarten through 12th grade, and, in connection therewith, declaring that school choice includes neighborhood, charter, and private schools; home schooling; open enrollment options; and future innovations in education?_
[**Experts to debate Prop 131 (Ranked Choice Voting) at Oct. 18 event in Grand Junction**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | OCTOBER 15** _With many Colorado voters already having ballots in hand, soon decisions will need to be made on a variety of ballot initiatives, not the least of which is Proposition 131._
[**Spanish language website, multilingual hotline offers voter resources to Coloradans**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 9** _All of the voter resources available to English-language speakers and readers are also available to Spanish-language speakers and readers in Colorado through VayaVotarColorado.gov, the office of Secretary of State Jena Griswold has announced._
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Homeless are ‘dumpster diving’ and rural police chief wants trespassing law to stop it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BOBBIE DANIEL | LOCAL | OCTOBER 16** _A new measure could be added to Fort Morgan's criminal code in response to a homeless man who may nearly have been killed as a result of living inside a dumpster on trash pickup day._

[**FEC filings contradict Democrat Frisch’s claims that he doesn’t take corporate PAC money**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY LINDY BROWNING | STATE | OCTOBER 16** _Adam Frisch, the Democratic nominee for Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District, has told his supporters in person, in debates, on social media and on national television, that he does not take corporate or PAC money._

[**Prop. 127’s ‘unintended consequences’ could be devastating, leaders in Northwest Colorado say**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY LINDY BROWNING | STATE | OCTOBER 16** _Members of the Associated Governments of Northwestern Colorado (AGNC) were joined recently in a discussion of Proposition 127 by Gaspar Perricone, of the Wildlife Conservation Project and formerly a political advisor, legislative director to the Colorado Department of Natural Resources and regional director for Sen. Mark Udall._

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Here's the reason you get so many emails
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2085%2E135344%2EHC1kFx)

Friend --
Sometimes it shocks me that anyone donates to fundraising emails from political campaigns.
If you're anything like me, you open your email in the morning and it's overflowing with emails from every Senate campaign, House campaign, the presidential campaign, party committees, and organizations you know and likely many you've never heard of. Most of the time I haven’t signed up for these lists.
I get why these emails happen: they are an increasingly important part of how campaigns and organizations are funded. Especially on the Democratic side. Our small dollar, online, and texting programs are light-years more productive than the GOP, and often account for a third of our monthly fundraising.
So in a sea of Democratic emails and texts, I do my best to differentiate our content, and edit every single one, including this one. The fact that you opened this email instead of deleting it and made it this far gives me hope there's a chance.
There is no winning the Senate without this race in Michigan. There is no winning the White House either. At the same time, this is going to be one of the most competitive (and expensive) races in the country. Poll after poll shows it razor tight.
Republicans know that too, that is why they're spending ridiculous amounts of money in to beat us. And since I don’t accept corporate PAC money, I have to rely on the generosity of individuals like you who understand the stakes of this race.
Hopefully that's a compelling case. It’s my job to make it. Because there's no winning this race without a significant response to emails like this by people like you.
[**Would you consider contributing $3 to my Senate campaign in Michigan to help me hold this seat, and the Senate, for Democrats in November? I can’t win without the help of people like you.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241018-1-900&t=2&akid=2085%2E135344%2EHC1kFx)**

Hi Peter, I should start by saying thank you. I know firsthand the power of the NDRC, because I was elected as the governor of Michigan with the support of this community in both 2018 and 2022. The NDRC also invested all across the state. They — you, Peter — ran through the wall to help elect Democrats running for the state legislature and to help pass the constitutional amendment that created the Michigan Independent Citizens Redistricting Commission. Thanks in large part to the support of this community, we now have a Democratic trifecta here in Michigan. And with this leadership, we’ve been able to pass pro-democracy legislation including the repeal of an antiquated 1931 abortion ban, the repeal of Michigan’s right-to-work law, and the expansion of our civil rights laws to include protections for the LGBTQ+ community. name: Mattea Mrkusic, Evergreen
subject: 🗣️ Tell your reps: LNG isn't in the public interest
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
There's nothing patriotic about volatile bills and poorer health
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2956522/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
| The evidence on LNG is clear, and the numbers don't lie. Thousands of activists have already spoken out against LNG export terminals poisoning our children, spoiling our coastlines, and making our energy costs more volatile. Now, it's up to our lawmakers to listen. [TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2956523/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi—

This summer, 5,610 Evergreen activists called on our members of Congress to support the Biden-Harris administration’s historic liquified "natural" gas (LNG) pause and do everything they can to hasten a just transition to a clean energy future.

But with [a new fossil industry-backed "study"](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2956524/87SdQ4wZ) cherry-picking data to mislead policymakers about the supposed economic benefits of LNG exports, **we need to ensure decision-makers hear from us. We must demand that they stand up for our communities instead of getting swayed by bogus reports.**

Will you send a message to your representatives in Congress right now? We're so close to **our goal of 7,000 signers** , and your voice can help put us over the top! |
---
[TELL CONGRESS: SUPPORT THE LNG PAUSE](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2956525/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| LNG is often cloaked in patriotic rhetoric. But there's nothing American about hitting families with more volatile energy costs that come from relying on the global fossil fuel markets, foreign leaders, and the whims of fossil fuel CEOs.

And **the health consequences of these polluting facilities are undeniable, especially for the predominantly Black, Brown, Indigenous, and low-income communities living steps and breaths away from them.** Forced to inhale toxic air, residents suffer from burning and irritated airways, in addition to even more serious illnesses like cancer, kidney and heart disease, and asthma.

The Department of Energy (DOE) is still assessing whether or not LNG export terminals are in the "public interest" in an economic and environmental studies review that will inform what happens next. That's why [**we must keep urging our members of Congress to protect DOE's authority and oppose any measures that would expand new LNG exports.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2956526/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[ADD YOUR VOICE NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2956527/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Thanks for all you do, |
---
| | |
---
### Mattea Mrkusic
Senior Policy Lead
Evergreen Action

But with cherry-picking data to mislead policymakers about the supposed economic benefits of LNG exports, we need to ensure decision-makers hear from us. We must demand that they stand up for our communities instead of getting swayed by bogus reports. Will you send a message to your representatives in Congress right now? We're so close to our goal of 7,000 signers , and your voice can help put us over the top! | | LNG is often cloaked in patriotic rhetoric. But there's nothing American about hitting families with more volatile energy costs that come from relying on the global fossil fuel markets, foreign leaders, and the whims of fossil fuel CEOs. And the health consequences of these polluting facilities are undeniable, especially for the predominantly Black, Brown, Indigenous, and low-income communities living steps and breaths away from them. Forced to inhale toxic air, residents suffer from burning and irritated airways, in addition to even more serious illnesses like cancer, kidney and heart disease, and asthma. The Department of Energy (DOE) is still assessing whether or not LNG export terminals are in the "public interest" in an economic and environmental studies review that will inform what happens next. Hello, it’s Barbra Streisand, and I want to share with you why I’m fully behind Jacky Rosen in Nevada’s must-win Senate race. [**_If you’re with me, will you consider making a donation to her campaign right now?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95268578/506173472/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5092-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzVjNmQ2MS00ZDhkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9q8V8kqC3l549XNUNEccaHmgYUdJqnvsx2sREE4j2oQ=)
Like Jacky, I have always been moved by the Jewish tradition of ‘Tikkun Olam,’ which means to leave the world better than how we found it. I truly believe that Jacky’s voice is the one we need in the Senate to better our country and our world.
Right now, experts are predicting that Jacky’s race will likely decide Senate control. That means that the outcome of her election could decide whether someone in this country can have a safe abortion, get affordable prescription drugs, access the ballot box – or even whether we will have free and fair elections going forward.
**But the last Senate race in Nevada was decided by just 7,928 votes – a margin of just 1% and the thinnest in the country. Now, polls show that this year’s election will be just as close. I know Jacky has what it takes to fight all the way down to the wire and win – but she can only do it if she has the resources she needs to fight back against the GOP.**
[**_That’s why I’m asking you: Will you please join me in supporting Jacky Rosen now by pitching in $5 or more to help her win in Nevada and continue fighting for a better world?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95268579/506173473/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5092-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzVjNmQ2MS00ZDhkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9q8V8kqC3l549XNUNEccaHmgYUdJqnvsx2sREE4j2oQ=)
Friend, after the recent Supreme Court decision on presidential immunity, Donald Trump would be able to wield the power of the presidential office virtually unchecked if re-elected. The only thing that terrifies me more than that is the thought of him working with a GOP-controlled Senate.
**That’s why we cannot afford to let Jacky lose in Nevada – because losing in Nevada means losing the Senate.** But Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump are doing everything in their power to prop up Jacky’s extreme GOP opponent – and dark money groups like the Koch network are pouring millions into Nevada to defeat her.
**That’s why I’m counting on you to join me in this fight to reelect Jacky as the leader we deserve in the Senate. With the stakes this high, none of us can stand on the sidelines. So please, friend:**

Hello, it’s Connie Schultz.
I have never reached out to all of you in a fundraising letter for Sherrod, but this is a time like no other.
Last month, Mitch McConnell and special-interest super PACs outspent us by $40 million. This money has funded a campaign full of lies and misinformation to attack Sherrod and inflict intentional harm on others.
So, here I am, asking for your help in these final days of this campaign.
In our twenty years of marriage, I’ve heard a lot of stories about Sherrod. I’m so inspired by how many of you – in person in Ohio and in letters from across the country – have shared stories about the Sherrod you know. You talk about how smart and informed he is, but you also describe his kindness and his habit of talking less and listening more. I am so moved by your stories of how Sherrod helped this person or that family, and how the people who work for him embody the highest aspirations of public service.
Your faith in him is well-founded. The Sherrod you know is the same Sherrod our family loves. And indulge this wife, please, as I add this: Nobody knows Sherrod like I do. I know how hard he works when no one is watching, and what keeps him up at night. I am by his side on those long walks with our dogs, Franklin and Walter, as he brainstorms out loud how to help individuals in need and entire communities in crisis. I know that no matter how much Sherrod does, he always feels there is more than he could do.
**That’s the senator you know and that’s the husband I love. Thank you for your faith in him.**

I like to keep one of those old-school Word of the Day tools around as a way to learn something new every day, and today's word is _insalubrious_.

Now, that's not one I use every day. In fact, I had to look it up.

And the definition is: unhealthy and unwholesome.

As in, _" Scholastic books fairs push insalubrious content on America's children."_

What a great way to describe the ever-growing selection of Scholastic books featuring LGBTQIA+ and gender-transitioning storylines and critical race theory themes, just to name a few.

Unlike Scholastic, all of our book fairs are offered _free of charge_ to schools and contain only age-appropriate books that my team has personally vetted. My team and I are committed to featuring wholesome, uplifting books with stories that foster imagination while being rooted in truth.

Since our founding, we've already...
* Set up over 280 book fairs in 23 states
* Reviewed and added 300+ titles to our book fair collection
* **Impacted over 30,000 students, with plans to reach 50,000 more this fall!**

I knew when SkyTree was founded that the book fair market needed an alternative to Scholastic, but demand has grown rapidly as parents, grandparents, and librarians realize the harm that Scholastic's _insalubrious_ content does to kids.

Scholastic is sneaky about their agenda, burying inappropriate content amidst innocent book offerings like _The Babysitters Club_ and _Captain Underpants_. Many of the books that Scholastic publishes or promotes in their book fairs and online catalogs include subject matter that should never be presented to children.

* _Cut_ \- a glimpse inside the mind of a 15-year-old girl who cuts herself
* _Escape from St. Hell: My Trans Teen Life Levels Up: A Graphic Novel_ \- this one pretty much speaks for itself...

At SkyTree Book Fairs, we believe that book fairs should offer books that _**let kids be kids**_ , not books aimed at indoctrinating them with radical ideologies.
