clean_body: "SkyTree Book Fairs" Hi Peter, I like to keep one of those old-school Word of the Day tools around as a way to learn something new every day, and today's word is insalubrious. Now, that's not one I use every day. In fact, I had to look it up. And the definition is: unhealthy and unwholesome. As in, " Scholastic books fairs push insalubrious content on America's children." What a great way to describe the ever-growing selection of Scholastic books featuring LGBTQIA+ and gender-transitioning storylines and critical race theory themes, just to name a few. I 'm not making this up! Keep on reading and see for yourself the books Scholastic is promoting to kids as young as 4 years old! If you're fed up with the insalubrious nature of the books featured in your local book fair, I invite you to join the SkyTree Book Fairs family tree! SkyTree Book Fairs was founded in 2023 as the safe and reliable alternative to Scholastic's monopoly in the school book fair market. Unlike Scholastic, all of our book fairs are offered free of charge to schools and contain only age-appropriate books that my team has personally vetted. My team and I are committed to featuring wholesome, uplifting books with stories that foster imagination while being rooted in truth. Since our founding, we've already... Set up over 280 book fairs in 23 states Reviewed and added 300+ titles to our book fair collection Impacted over 30,000 students, with plans to reach 50,000 more this fall! I knew when SkyTree was founded that the book fair market needed an alternative to Scholastic, but demand has grown rapidly as parents, grandparents, and librarians realize the harm that Scholastic's insalubrious content does to kids. Scholastic is sneaky about their agenda, burying inappropriate content amidst innocent book offerings like The Babysitters Club and Captain Underpants. Many of the books that Scholastic publishes or promotes in their book fairs and online catalogs include subject matter that should never be presented to children. Like these titles from their Power of Story line, an agenda-driven line of children's books that may show up in school book fairs and libraries this year: For PreK - Grade 3: You Are Brave: A Book About Trying New Things \- encourages kids to show the world how brave they are with LGBTQIA+ messaging. For Grades 3-7: Asking for a Friend \- a story about queer joy and all the ups and downs of true friendship. For Grades 7 & Up: Cut \- a glimpse inside the mind of a 15-year-old girl who cuts herself Escape from St. Hell: My Trans Teen Life Levels Up: A Graphic Novel \- this one pretty much speaks for itself... At SkyTree Book Fairs, we believe that book fairs should offer books that let kids be kids , not books aimed at indoctrinating them with radical ideologies. Growing up presents enough challenges. Kids certainly don't need to have their minds filled with the confusing, disturbing, and insalubrious content Scholastic will be bringing to schools across the country this semester. The good news is that across the country, moms and dads are waking up to indoctrination going on in their children's schools and demanding better. They're demanding SkyTree Book Fairs. And I couldn't be more excited to share our wholesome book fair experience, but I need your help! I've set a big, hairy, audacious goal of raising $200,000 to fully fund the over 150 book fairs scheduled in the fall semester. To keep bringing these fairs to schools free of charge, I'm relying on your generosity. Help SkyTree Book Fairs end Scholastic 's monopoly on the book fair market! Thank you in advance for your support! God Bless, Riley Lee President & CEO SkyTree Book Fairs is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization. Copyright SkyTree Book Fairs, 2023.

name: Dave McCormick
subject: Duty, Honor, and Country vs. Typical Career Politician
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
You deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/12lqB6zE8WDbK3QBMJnycA~~/AARclAA~~)

Friend,

If you watched the second debate, you heard a lot of “career politician talk” from my opponent Bob Casey.

He lied about me, he lied about his record, and he refused to take responsibility for the failures he and the rest of the DC liberals have caused to our economy and at the border.

**On Day One in the Army, you learn to take responsibility for your actions, but Bob Casey is a typical career politician. He takes zero responsibility. **

At one point he even had the nerve to lecture me about the conflict in the Middle East. _I went to West Point, Ranger School, and was a platoon leader in the 82nd Airborne Division during the First Gulf War and received a Bronze Star for my service._

**I 'm not going to be lectured by a guy who has spent 30 years in elected office with NOTHING to show for it but a weak voting record that lines up 99% of the time with Biden/Harris.**

We had a code at West Point: cadets don't lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do. I'm not going to tolerate Bob Casey's lies.

I'm no stranger to tough battles. But with under 3 weeks left until Election Day, the polls locked in a dead heat, and control of the Senate majority hinging on the outcome of my race, **[I need your help in this fight.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/12lqB6zE8WDbK3QBMJnycA~~/AARclAA~~)**
[DONATE NOW](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/12lqB6zE8WDbK3QBMJnycA~~/AARclAA~~)
---

It's not just on the debate stage where I'm facing an onslaught of attacks. **Democrats are pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into Pennsylvania to obliterate my chances of flipping the Senate Red.**

I cannot stress enough how close this race is.

We're locked in a tied race.

The outcome of this election will come down to a dogfight in the final days as we fight for _every. single. vote._

That's why I'm asking for your help to fund this final stretch, get my message out, and expose the truth about Bob Casey's failed liberal record.

**[Will you rush in anything you can to help me cut through the noise and get the truth out?](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/12lqB6zE8WDbK3QBMJnycA~~/AARclAA~~)**
[DONATE NOW](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/12lqB6zE8WDbK3QBMJnycA~~/AARclAA~~)
---

**Here 's the truth about Bob Casey.** Bob Casey has accomplished NOTHING after 18 years in the U.S. Senate. He's supported policies that have increased the cost of living, left our border wide open, and he's supported a plan to raise taxes on working Pennsylvanians. He's anti-business and anti-success. And did I mention he wants to get rid of the Senate filibuster?

I'm running for Senate because Pennsylvanians deserve a leader who will fight for the American Dream. YOU deserve a leader who will change the course of the country for the better.

As a West Point cadet, I took an oath of "Duty, Honor, and Country." I live by that motto every day. It's how I've run my campaign and it's how I'll lead in the Senate.

But in order to get there, I need your help today. **[So if you are able, please chip in anything you can to my campaign before time runs out.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/12lqB6zE8WDbK3QBMJnycA~~/AARclAA~~)**

Thank you,
Dave McCormick

Many of us are experiencing some degree of PTSD as we are reliving some of the insanity and misinformation of the 2016 election. There is so much riding on the upcoming U.S. presidential election, especially for the millions of eligible voters with disabilities. Our healthcare, our benefits, and our access to everyday necessities are on the chopping block! name: Andy Cohen
subject: Josh Hawley’s deep personal involvement in the nationwide assault on reproductive freedom.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal
involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive
freedom, then keep reading.

It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the
Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth
control for their workers. He even said contraceptives “may induce an
abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg” — which, to be
clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every
medical professional.

Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his
extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors
as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his
taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to
overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to
ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal
personhood” bills at the national level.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]On the left, a headline from The Guardian: Hawley's anti-abortion
arguments echoed in AL IVF case. On the right, a headline from the
Washington Post: Nominee who is anti-IVF and surrogacy was deemed
unqualified. Hawley: 'I was proud to recommend her.'

Then, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF and our
right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee access to
IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?

Hawley told the media the Right To IVF Act was really part of an “abortion
agenda.”

I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big
Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our
doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose
to build and raise OUR families.

And if he gets another six years to finish what he’s started, then the
ability to build a family like mine — or even likely a family like yours —
could be made impossible.

Josh Hawley poses a unique and existential threat to reproductive freedom,
and this is our one chance to put a stop to his crusade against our
freedoms. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]We can’t afford to give him another six years in the U.S.
Senate — so, I'm asking: Can you please add a donation to Lucas Kunce’s
campaign today so we can secure our freedoms?

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your
contribution instantly:

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78407?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1010&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Contribute $10
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78407?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=1011&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Contribute $25
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78407?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=1012&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Contribute $30
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78407?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=1013&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Contribute $50
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78407?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=1014&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Contribute $100
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78407?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=1015&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Contribute $250
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1016&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]Give another amount

I warned you already this was a long email, so you can’t blame me for
wanting to tell you a bit more about Lucas Kunce and why I know he can
defeat Josh Hawley — but only if he has your help. Lucas is the Marine
veteran and born-and-raised Missourian taking Hawley on this November.
He’s built a record-breaking movement and is drawing huge crowds at events
across the state.

And he’s even sharing the ballot this November with a referendum to end
the Hawley-backed abortion ban in Missouri, which will be a huge boost for
Democratic turnout just as it has been in red and purple states across the
country in recent elections.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1017&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]New York Times headline: Abortion Rights Fuel Big Democratic Wins, and
Hopes for 2024

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1018&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]CHIP IN TO ELECT LUCAS

Not long ago, Missourians came together to defeat Todd Akin after his
extreme views on abortion came to light, but that didn’t happen overnight.

Akin exposed himself in August of that election year, and a poll that same
month showed him with an 11% lead. It took weeks and MONTHS of hard work,
advertising, and organizing to expose Akin’s extremism to Missouri voters
— and because we all came together, Missourians rejected Akin on Election
Day by a 15% margin (a total change of 26% from August).

And while you might be surprised to hear about Democrats doing that well
in a red state, that kind of result isn’t rare in Missouri.

In our last U.S. Senate race that took place in a presidential election,
Jason Kander outperformed the presidential ticket by 16%, nearly defeating
incumbent Roy Blunt, who had the entire GOP establishment behind him. In
fact, the race against Blunt got close with almost identical timing to the
race against Akin — Kander was polling by as much as 14% behind Blunt, but
after pushing hard on ads and organizing starting in the fall, the race
was neck-and-neck.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1019&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]On top, a Spectrum News headline: Recent poll found Hawley was the
least popular GOP senator up for reelection among voters. In the middle,
AP headline: Missouri abortion-rights campaign turns in more than double
the needed signatures to get on the ballot. On the bottom, a quote from
Jason Kander in the KC Star: 'Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley. Anyone
who cares about democracy, reproductive freedom, and working families,
this race should be a priority.'

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY

Now I’m going to say something you may not want to hear, but it is true
and important for this race: Josh Hawley is more extreme than Donald Trump
and almost every Republican on reproductive freedom. In fact, he
objectively has the worst record on reproductive rights of any U.S.
Senator. That means we don’t have to wait for Hawley to have a “Todd Akin
moment” — his entire six years in the Senate has been one.

But it’s an election year, which means Josh Hawley will be telling all
sorts of lies to voters claiming he’s not responsible for this assault on
our freedoms. And that’s where you and me come in.

We need to help Lucas expose Hawley’s anti-freedom crusade to Missouri
voters on TV, online, at their doors, and in their mailboxes, and that
takes resources. [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78406?refcode=em20241018-8123&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=8123%2E614464%2Ema8Aci ]So if it wasn’t clear already, your support could

Y’all, if you’d told me when I was starting my first job as a special education teacher that one day I’d be writing an email to you as the _Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Tennessee_ , I’d have laughed you outta the room. My folks didn’t talk much about politics growing up. In fact, they were Republicans. But they showed me what it means to care about your community. They helped out kids in need — and they inspired me to do the same. I went into special education to help level the playing field. Each and every one of our kids deserves the support to reach their full potential. I am so proud of the work I did in our schools. But I know that there’s more to do. There are so many critical issues that need our attention. I’m someone who has had an abortion, and now I’m furious at the far-right radicals who are taking away women’s right to make our own medical decisions. While working in education for nearly three decades, I saw firsthand the impact of gun violence in schools. And in my own family, we had people suffer because they couldn’t afford healthcare before the Affordable Care Act. **As Tennessee’s next Senator, I’ll fight _every single day_ to restore women’s reproductive rights, keep our communities safe from gun violence, improve healthcare access and affordability, and more. I’m ready to do the work.** **_[I just need your help to defeat my well-funded opponent and the entrenched GOP establishment on November 5th. Truly, any grassroots contribution you make now would mean the world — and go a long way to returning real representation to Tennessee. subject: Podcast makes waves in PA election
body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This segment dives into key issues for Pennsylvania voters heading into the general election, focusing on cost-of-living, infrastructure, energy, housing, and the economy at large.

**A debate between two veteran GOP strategists** **is making waves** , each supporting a different presidential candidate. Plus, **U.S. Congressman Scott Perry** shared insights you won't want to miss in the Keystone Candidate Forum.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **U.S. Congressman Scott Perry** stated, "every single person deserves to know what the playing field is and to realize their maximum potential," acknowledging that achieving the American Dream has become increasingly difficult.** **[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=82ef5c399a&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Haley Voters for Harris PA Director Craig Snyder** expressed a longing for a return to a rational center-right Republican Party, contrasting it with the current state of Trumpism, which he views as harmful to American society.** **[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=93d1b25439&e=b7b3eddce2)]** **
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Public Opinion_
* **46% of PA voters say they are “worse off” **than a year ago, a sentiment consistent over recent years. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8b67ffca13&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Elon Musk**donated $75 million** to a pro-Trump PAC and is offering free talks to PA voters, drawing concern over election laws. [[Penn Live](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=cb80240ee8&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* The U.S. is accumulating **debt at a rate of $1 trillion every 100 days.** [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0b3b91b1b1&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* **86% of the PA residents** believe that shale gas development is important to the state’s economy. [[Resources Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=694820638a&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Companies across PA have still not claimed any of the **$2.6 billion tax credit package** which was enacted in 2022 to encourage natural gas use. [[Spotlight PA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=dc3ff053a0&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* **Registered Democrats in Erie County dropped 18%** over the past four years in the key presidential swing county. [[Newsweek](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e91358457d&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Rep. Scott Perry talks U.S. affordability crisis in Keystone Candidate Forum**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9ec5d3da97&e=b7b3eddce2 "Rep. Scott Perry on PA Economy, Energy, and Infrastructure – Keystone Candidate Forum Preview")
---
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
| Airing next week, **you will hear from** **all three candidates** running in PA's closely contested Attorney General race.

Candidates touched upon the AG's relationship to the state economy, local DAs, and—most importantly—the high-stakes drama of Philly and Pittsburgh pro sports.
---
|
---
|
* * *
---
| _In Case You Missed It..._

Tune in for **a debate between two long-time Republican strategists** , Craig Snyder and Dennis Powell. PA's swing state voters will determine who wins the presidency – each participant makes his case for the top of the ticket.
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a2bd609bc7&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a9afd16cfa&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7a87fa1b7c&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0f4f635c48&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=deca43ba2a&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=fa67da60b3&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.
Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1036531e90&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=aa4ecef2e34348788c34b15cc98a0166&_e=P_jXOrgt1_jnjfGw4eh8ojgZZlq9q0fWC1I9ODKgLRKTwrV6BSwM_oY3sSXs4297oJrPaudPeTRUUOdX2cBf_68aCM5CI6mMU7cYM1Gg62KBC1h9ClX1vNiS1nNUNxS0iFHS0ie5vDUDixzAbN8EYvqJSKaKm8wmwUpnZ14cW-vcrb55jA1H6zddG7watEj86XBpm_uoBTj5yeZjAPr3HlixlKJPB7OOiOB37kmknBL9iN8hbARuNMzvZbXJ3k_lGRwAwZLhvRr03bEydvrMTEkJho-CScECste6pPZbbhTBmauQKKWwNJ3p-nnTzhOWCfxTQT1QaHLOPKLT3gMm0WmXGt8qW-l_wotCB5QazaJxM4fDtKOvHYtieTTVgsxO-PxlW1hCYoh_rSOGHDirMA%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=aa4ecef2e34348788c34b15cc98a0166&_e=P_jXOrgt1_jnjfGw4eh8ojgZZlq9q0fWC1I9ODKgLRKTwrV6BSwM_oY3sSXs4297oJrPaudPeTRUUOdX2cBf_68aCM5CI6mMU7cYM1Gg62KBC1h9ClX1vNiS1nNUNxS0iFHS0ie5vDUDixzAbN8EYvqJSKaKm8wmwUpnZ14cW-vcrb55jA1H6zddG7watEj86XBpm_uoBTj5yeZjAPr3HlixlKJPB7OOiOB37kmknBL0KVTmdkoJ5F8KsWeOOUUwww7WM95DOWiiIn6kT0_t4mYc8AYGEvlOLJ9Vt_lkrDZP9kiM7D47EV2iI9s4aW6WnUJ0kQcIVW_l6uHY6RjZ9VA2AsU99A2Ibu9Nif5BV0ycF-Fyw-BztvymQSL56PTvzOXpymZ9UgdeV_PjGP4BBA%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! body:
Have you heard what our opponents are saying?
| | |
---
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re in the middle of some pretty tight races in Ohio and Montana that you’ve probably heard about. But have you heard what our opponents are saying? 👇
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95286933/506227122/-1116450233?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1675-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Y2I3Zjk1Yy01YjhkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7SOHF-n035aedYzemTmYHqjS2H7_yM3Y9VSNuZffUvs=)
Bernie Moreno, said it's **"a little crazy"** that women in Ohio are voting to defend reproductive rights. Tim Sheehy thinks young women who care about abortion access are **“indoctrinated.”**
You read that right. They have once again shown us exactly who they are – extremists who will put their own out-of-touch agenda before the health and safety of women _everywhere_.
And the difference between us could not be more clear: We know these decisions should be left between a woman and her doctor, and that no government official, _least of all these two_ , should be forcing their way into the doctor’s office.

| Running for office is tough. You have to ask a bunch of people for money (like this), and then the other side gets together and says lots of mean things about you. Having a baby is tough, too. There’s lots of screaming and crying, poop gets everywhere, and you don’t get any sleep. Now that I think about it, it’s a lot like running for office... Peter, I’m writing because my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is doing BOTH. First, I laughed and told him he was crazy. When I realized he wasn’t joking, I said I’d help! [Josh is running for Congress in NY-19, and his race could decide the House majority. Will you join me and split a contribution between Josh Riley and Blue Amp Action today to help him win one of the most important races in the country?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7517a21d-e8cf-467a-aeef-fd0754c50ec8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Josh is used to doing things the hard way. He grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood in Endicott, NY. When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law. In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law. Now, Josh is running for Congress without taking any corporate PAC money. He knows it’s not the easy route, but it’s the right thing to do. But that means he’s relying on folks like you and me chipping in. And with his time spread thin between the campaign, the new baby and, ya know, still having time to breathe, he’s relying on us now more than ever. [So if you can, please split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today. Josh’s race will be one of the most competitive in the entire country, and he’ll win it with our help.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb7ec6800-8082-4489-8759-1791f0d9dff3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: Tonight 8pm Symposium -- Designing A New International Monetary System: The Lessons of Bretton Woods

---
Friend -- Winning the war does not necessarily mean winning the peace. The battle to control the "rules" of a post-war system is as intense in many ways as the wars that accompany the demise of the previous system. As we see the inevitable collapse of the "neo-liberal system" controlled from the West, we will discuss in tonight's symposium the history and battles involved in establishing the post-WWII "Bretton Woods System." What went right, and what went wrong? We have much to say about this process of the Bretton Woods -- old and potentially new. Lyndon LaRouche warned at the time of the take down of the original Bretton Woods System in 1971, when the dollar was taken off the gold reserve system and a "floating currency rate" system was established, that such a system would lead to a reemergence of fascism and war. LaRouche moved then to create a new, just system presenting his call for an "International Development Bank" in 1974. LaRouche called his 2000 presidential campaign "The Committee for a New Bretton Woods." In 2022, Helga Zepp-LaRouche issued a petition for international support for a New Bretton Woods System. She wrote at that time: "There is a growing concern about World War III and, while people are against war, they are not looking at the cause. It is the collapse globally of the neo-liberal system which is responsible for the war drive coming from the G7 and NATO." While ridiculing the dog-and-pony show of their summits, she pointed to the serious discussion at the BRICS-Plus summit as an example of the potential to achieve a global bankruptcy reorganization. As to why connect her petition with Bretton Woods, she said that it represented a precedent for such a global agreement and that, although the hijacking of FDR’s original proposal prevented the full decolonization he intended, the BRICS-Plus have now put that back on the agenda. By contrast, "The G7 and NATO are launching a global operation which does not address any of the immediate threats facing mankind. Our proposal does," she said. The BRICS summit this year, which will conclude on October 24, will put forward proposals for a new financial system. Tonight's symposium will discuss the history of the original Bretton Woods System and the importance of how a new system will be created today. Two days after the close of this BRICS summit, my campaign, together with Jose Vega's campaign, are sponsoring [**a major meeting for peace and development in New York City**](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=f0Ng0twrshqbKUTXteMyqY_i4zbPpm0ZunUyXdKXTeJ4OP1IW7gsSZx0-y9VmBRV&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=symposium_october_18&n=2). We encourage you to attend!

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: We're only days from EARLY VOTING / Falta una semana para la VOTACIÓN TEMPRANA
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
GET READY:
Early voting starts Monday, Oct. 21
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20megaphone.jpg]
REMINDER: Early voting starts MONDAY, October 21 in the 2024 Presidential Election and runs through Friday, November 1. Election Day is Tuesday, November 5.
As we prepare to cast our ballots, let's remember we are worth more than GOP politicians in power in our state who spew hate, try to divide us, and then abandon us in times of trouble.
Together, we can vote into office true people-powered leaders at the county, state, and federal level who share our values and who will prioritize the needs of working Texans, not restrict our rights and fearmonger. Our vote is our power!
Check out these resources so that you're #VoteReady:
- Access a full list of TOP-endorsed candidates committed to building a #TXForAll. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
- See what will be on your ballot at Vote411.org. [https://www.vote411.org/]
- Find early vote polling locations and hours in your county. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/where.html]
- Visit GoVoteTexas.org for acceptable forms of photo ID to bring with you to vote. [https://govotetexas.org/] (Don't forget it!)
Taking the fight to Ted
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Colin%20Allred%20candidate%20screening%20Dallas.jpg]
If you didn’t catch Tuesday’s debate between TOP-endorsed Colin Allred and Ted Cruz, you’ll want to watch the highlights, [https://www.fox4news.com/news/colin-allred-ted-cruz-senate-debate-highlights] because it’s clear Colin came to DEBATE. At numerous points throughout the night, Colin called out Senator Cruz for being the slimy politician he is, while showing viewers what true leadership looks like.
Building a stronger, more progressive, and inclusive Texas means electing responsive leaders who will fight for a future where ALL in our state can thrive — no matter what part of Texas you live, the language you speak, or how much money you have in your pocket.
That's why TOP is proud to be endorsing Colin Allred, an accomplished civil rights attorney and member of Congress , who has shown he's committed to championing issues important to our communities — such as good-paying jobs, quality public schools, legal system reform, and the expansion of healthcare access.
In solidarity with our Indigenous communities
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Indigenous%20Peoples%20Day%202024%20TOP%20social%20media%20graphic.png]
The contributions made by Indigenous peoples the world over are vast, invaluable, and forever woven into the fabric of our society. Audacious in every which way, Indigenous communities for centuries have withstood the destructive force of racial capitalism and white supremacy.
Their unshakeable resistance against the genocidal tool of colonization serves as a stark reminder why our movement’s fight for the liberation of us all – no matter the color of our skin, the language we speak, or where we call home – is as vital as it is non-negotiable. We know full well that Indigenous rights are human rights, and that our efforts to advance racial and economic justice for Black and Latino Texans will always be intertwined. It’s one reason why TOP now shares land acknowledgments in our organizing spaces.
Each and every day, we are building solidarity across communities of color in our state , as TOP seeks to dismantle the systemic racism that for too long has held back Black, Latino, and Indigenous people, and instead manifest a #TXForAll vision rooted in freedom and justice.
TOP Tip: Stock up on union-made treats for Halloween
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Halloween%20union%20graphic.jpg]
Take your solidarity with our union brothers and sisters to a sweet new level this Halloween by purchasing union-made candy! Use this list as a guide. [https://labor411.org/shopping-list/union-made-halloween-candy-guide/]
Español
PREPÁRESE:
La votación temprana comienza el lunes 21 de octubre
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20megaphone.jpg]
RECORDATORIO: La votación anticipada comienza el LUNES 21 de octubre en las elecciones presidenciales de 2024 y se extenderá hasta el viernes 1 de noviembre. El día de las elecciones es el martes 5 de noviembre.
Mientras nos preparamos para emitir nuestro voto, recordemos que valemos más que los políticos republicanos que están en el poder en nuestro estado y que arrojan odio, intentan dividirnos y luego nos abandonan en tiempos difíciles.
Juntos, podemos elegir a verdaderos líderes impulsados por el pueblo a nivel de condado, estado y federal que compartan nuestros valores y que prioricen las necesidades de los trabajadores de Texas, en lugar de restringir nuestros derechos y sembrar el miedo. ¡Nuestro voto es nuestro poder!
Consulte estos recursos para estar listos #VoteReady:
- Acceda a una lista completa de los candidatos respaldados por TOP comprometidos con la construcción de un #TXForAll [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/] .
- Vea lo que estará en su boleta en Vote411.org. [https://www.vote411.org/]
- Encuentre los lugares y horarios de votación anticipada en su condado. [https://www.votetexas.gov/voting/where.html]
- Visite GoVoteTexas.org para conocer los documentos de identificación con fotografía que se aceptan para llevar al lugar de votación. [https://govotetexas.org/] (¡No lo olvide!)
Hacer frente a Ted
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Colin%20Allred%20candidate%20screening%20Dallas.jpg]
Si no vio el debate del martes entre el candidato que cuenta con el apoyo de TOP Colin Allred y Ted Cruz, querrá ver los momentos destacados [https://www.fox4news.com/news/colin-allred-ted-cruz-senate-debate-highlights] , porque está claro que Colin vino a DEBATE. En numerosos momentos a lo largo de la noche, Colin criticó al senador Cruz por ser el político viscoso que es, mientras mostraba a los espectadores cómo es el verdadero liderazgo.
Construir un Texas más fuerte, más progresista e inclusivo significa elegir líderes receptivos que luchen por un futuro en el que TODOS en nuestro estado puedan prosperar, sin importar en qué parte de Texas viva, el idioma que hable o cuánto dinero tenga en el bolsillo.
Es por eso que TOP se enorgullece de respaldar a Colin Allred, un consumado abogado de derechos civiles y miembro del Congreso , que ha demostrado su compromiso con la defensa de cuestiones importantes para nuestras comunidades, como empleos bien remunerados, escuelas públicas de calidad, reforma del sistema legal y la expansión del acceso a la atención médica.
En solidaridad con nuestras comunidades indigenas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Indigenous%20Peoples%20Day%202024%20TOP%20social%20media%20graphic.png]
Las contribuciones de los pueblos indígenas de todo el mundo son enormes, invaluables y están entrelazadas para siempre en el tejido de nuestra sociedad. Audaces en todos los sentidos, las comunidades indígenas han resistido durante siglos la fuerza destructiva del capitalismo racial y la supremacía blanca.
Su resistencia inquebrantable contra la herramienta genocida de la colonización sirve como un claro recordatorio de por qué la lucha de nuestro movimiento por la liberación de todos nosotros, sin importar el color de nuestra piel, el idioma que hablamos o dónde vivimos, es tan vital como innegociable. Sabemos muy bien que los derechos indígenas son derechos humanos y que nuestros esfuerzos por promover la justicia racial y económica para los texanos negros y latinos siempre estarán entrelazados. Es una de las razones por las que TOP ahora comparte los reconocimientos de tierras en nuestros espacios de organización.
Todos los días, construimos solidaridad entre las comunidades de color en nuestro estado , mientras TOP busca desmantelar el racismo sistémico que durante demasiado tiempo ha frenado a las personas negras, latinas e indígenas, y en su lugar manifestar una visión #TXForAll arraigada en la libertad y la justicia.
Consejos de TOP: Abastécete de golosinas elaboradas por sindicatos para Halloween
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Halloween%20union%20graphic.jpg]
¡Lleve su solidaridad con nuestros hermanos y hermanas sindicalistas a un nuevo nivel este Halloween comprando dulces elaborados por sindicatos! Use esta lista como guía. [https://labor411.org/shopping-list/union-made-halloween-candy-guide/]

body:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95296292/506256843/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5115-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDlkODI4Ny02NjhkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cQjmYCyJe8oqkFgbGaFwXmeJIb2W4A0tsGPM5JmPiPI=)
Friend: Sorry to reach out like this, but this couldn’t wait.
I’m sure you’re making tough decisions about where to spend your hard-earned dollars as we get closer to the election, so I want to explain why Nevada is the state where your donation will have the greatest impact today. **[But if you’re short on time, I hope you’ll chip in $5 right now to support me in my must-win Senate race.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95296293/506256844/1399466761?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5115-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NDlkODI4Ny02NjhkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cQjmYCyJe8oqkFgbGaFwXmeJIb2W4A0tsGPM5JmPiPI=)**
**_1) Political experts agree:_** There is no hope of maintaining our Senate majority OR Democratic control of the White House if we lose Nevada.
**_2) Once again:_** Nevada is going to come down to razor-thin margins. In 2022, Democrats won here by just 0.77% of the vote (the closest margin in the entire country). And this year is shaping up to be just as close.
**_3) Right NOW:_** I'm getting absolutely overwhelmed on the airwaves as national Republicans and dark money groups spend $60 MILLION to try to buy this seat.

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Republican Videos + Rural Call Reminder
body:
Pray. Share. Do More. | |
---
| | | _**“Lord, I pray that I will not fear my neighbors that have Trump signs in their yards.” **_

Amen. This prayer comes from someone in our community. We’re sharing it so you can keep them in prayer, and as a reminder that we walk with Jesus wherever we go so **let’s keep each other in prayer as we courageously journey together in our support for Harris and Walz.**

What else can we do? **Here are powerful testimonies from two courageous, Republican lawmakers \- both men of faith, who are standing up for Harris because they know she best embodies our Christian values of care and compassion for others and because she will work with Republicans to do what’s best for our country. **Please **watch and share** these with your networks, **tagging your family and friends in your posts, especially those in battleground states.**

[Bob Inglis](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=89ef4c01a5&e=43463f1dee), former US House of Representatives (R-SC)
[Adam Kinzinger](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=1ecd1a6c29&e=43463f1dee), former House of Representatives (R-IL)

As a reminder we’re having a [**rural Evangelicals for Harris supporter call**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=c1441f7b53&e=43463f1dee)** Tues. Oct. 22 from 8-9 pm EDT. **Please join us for prayer, encouragement, and to learn more about Harris and Walz policies that will help rural families and all of us. Please [register here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=de17b4527f&e=43463f1dee) and share this invitation with your family and friends who might be interested. This is an off the record conversation.

Let us know [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=d15281f7e0&e=43463f1dee) if you’d like to be more involved with us and to share your prayer requests. Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

You see, America is going down a dangerous path, and I’m worried we’re running out of time to turn things around.

But before I get into how we can save America before it’s too late, let me tell you a little bit of my story.

America saved my life. My father was put on a kill list in Vietnam by the invading communists, and we escaped just days before Saigon fell.

In 2020, Republicans flipped this seat from blue to red by the slimmest margin of any House race in nearly an entire century – a margin of just 6 votes (0.01% of the vote). And polling confirms it could be just as competitive this November. Normington, Petts & Associates Poll: Bohannan 47% – Miller-Meeks 47% = Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-1) – Amish is an Emergency Room physician at the Mayo Clinic of Arizona and State Representative who had the most bills signed into law of any Arizona Democrat of the past decade. In 2022, Republicans barely defended this seat by a margin of just 3,195 votes (which was less than 1% of the vote). It could be even closer this time around. In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by 1.5%. Impact Research Poll: Shah 48% – Schweikert 48% = Janelle Bynum (OR-5) – Janelle is an electrical engineer, small business owner, and former State Representative who has defeated Republican Lori Chavez-DeRemer (who she is now running against) not once but twice at the state level. In 2022, Republicans flipped this seat from blue to red by a razor-thin margin of just 2.1% of the vote. In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by 8.8% of the vote – one of the largest margins of any House seat actively held by a Republican. Noble Predictive Insights Poll: Bynum 43% – Chavez-DeRemer 42% = George Whitesides (CA-27) – George is an aerospace expert who served as the Chief of Staff for NASA under President Barack Obama, served as CEO of the spaceflight company Virgin Galactic, and co-founded a group to address wildfire disasters. In 2020, Republicans flipped this seat from blue to red by a razor-thin margin – just 333 votes (a margin of 0.1% of the vote). In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by a massive margin of 12.4% of the vote – more than almost any other House district currently represented by a Republican. University of Southern California Poll: Whitesides 48% – Garcia 46% = John Mannion (NY-22) – John is a former science teacher who won a highly competitive State Senate seat on Republican turf by just 10 votes to win a seat in the New York State Legislature. In 2022, Republicans barely defended this House seat by a razor-thin margin of just 2,631 votes (which is less than 1% of the vote!). In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by a margin of 7.4% of the vote – which is part of the reason the National Journal labeled this as the best red-to-blue pickup opportunity in the United States! = Tony Vargas (NE-2) – Tony is a former science teacher and school board member who currently serves in the Nebraska State Senate. In 2022, Tony fell just 5,856 votes (a margin of just 2.6% of the vote) of flipping this seat from red to blue. In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by a margin of 6.4% of the vote and it's only grown more Democratic since. body:
We are in the final stages of this campaign and we need your help Saturday and Monday. | | | | |
---
| Hello:
Team Merrin is in the home stretch of our race to unseat Marcy Kaptur. In her 42 year career, she has never been this worried about winning re-election. After bombarding her with TV ads, mail, and digital ads, her unfavorability has skyrocketed, and we are so close to winning this race, which is why we need your help to get us across the finish line.
This**Saturday** we are dedicating all of our campaign resources to **phone banking.** Phone banking has proven to be a very successful way to get to our voters this cycle. The outpouring of support we are getting is encouraging and our supporters receiving the calls appreciate our effort.
**We will begin calling at 10am and will have lunch at noon. Please let us know when you will be available to make calls and we will make a shift work for you. We will be calling from 10am to 3pm.**
We ask that you bring a charged phone for this effort because we use an app on our phones.
On**Monday, October 21st** we will have our **final letter writing party at 5:30PM**. We have all the envelopes, stamps, and materials necessary, and you can swing by the office and pick up materials to bring home with you, too. Pizza and beverages will be provided as well.
Thanks to you we are making thousands of phone calls a week and we have completed three quarters of the letters we need to send.
The phone bank and letter writing will be at 1306 Kittle Road, Holland, Ohio 43528
Please let us know when you are available. Reach out to Justin Barnhart at (419) 231-1111.
Regards,Derek Merrin Campaign Team

Friend,

I want to tell you why I’m inspired by Dan Osborn, an industrial mechanic running to be Nebraska’s next senator.

But first, I need your help. Dan is under attack from Mitch McConnell and right-wing billionaire-funded super PACs. They know he could be the deciding vote in the US Senate. We can’t let them do it.

Can you rush a contribution to Dan’s campaign right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241018-lift]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241018-lift [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241018-lift]

Dan Osborn knows what it’s like to work for a living. A Navy and Nebraska National Guard veteran, he put his college education on hold and took a job as an industrial mechanic at the Kellogg’s plant in Omaha to support his family. He worked 50-, 60-, and sometimes 90-hour weeks. During his last year at the factory, he picked up 33 different 16-hour shifts on Sundays to give his family a better life.

Dan was elected president of his union, BCTGM Local 50G. He successfully led a 77-day strike in 2021 at the Omaha Kellogg’s plant, securing 500 jobs and worker benefits. Kellogg’s retaliated by firing Osborn for leading the strike.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241018-lift [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241018-lift]

FiveThirtyEight is calling this the closest Senate race in the country. Five brand-new polls show Dan is narrowly leading his Republican opponent, Deb Fischer, and Republicans are getting scared. Mitch McConnell and his Super PAC billionaire buddies are spending over $8.8 million on new TV ads attacking Dan. They know that if he’s elected, he will hold the 51st vote needed to stop a complete national abortion ban, get money out of politics, and take on the billionaires.

Dan isn’t taking any corporate PAC money because he isn’t in this race to represent corporations or the wealthy. He spent 20 years working for a major corporation, and he knows how important it is for working Americans to have a seat at the table.

The polls are clear: this is a Senate race we can win. But Dan can’t do it alone.

Can you rush a donation today to show Dan the nation has his back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241018-lift]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-osborn-split?refcode=20241016]

Thank you for your support, your activism, and everything you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

body:
I know $5 doesn’t sound like the kind of money that can win a Senate campaign, or stop a guy like Trump.
#

If you knew a donation of $5 could prevent Donald from becoming President of the United States, wouldn’t you chip it in right away?
If you knew that $5 could defeat Kari Lake and help us get one seat closer to our Senate Majority, wouldn’t that be the best $5 you’ve ever spent?
Peter, I know what you’re thinking. I know $5 doesn’t sound like the kind of money that can win a Senate campaign, or stop a guy like Trump.
But I’m here to tell you that driven people working together in good faith towards a common goal is the only thing that’s ever made a difference. I really believe that.
And when you chip in, it’s not just your $5 alone. It’s hundreds, thousands of others adding what they can afford to donate, too. When all those people come together and donate, it adds up fast.
That’s not just how we hit our goals, or raise what we need. It’s how we win. Together.

This is our best chance, Peter.

Peter: Birth control is basic healthcare that should be accessible to everyone. There are no ifs, ands, or buts about it. **We must establish the federal right to access ALL forms of FDA-approved birth control.** In the aftermath of 2022’s _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ , which effectively overturned the protections of Roe v. Wade – our reproductive rights have been ceaselessly under attack. **Now more than ever, we need legislation that protects the right to bodily autonomy, personal choice, and equitable access to healthcare.** I refuse to stand by as our country devolves further and further into a nation where the right to choose is criminalized. There are no ifs, ands, or buts about it. We must establish the federal right to access ALL forms of FDA-approved birth control. In the aftermath of 2022’s Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization , which effectively overturned the protections of Roe v. Wade – our reproductive rights have been ceaselessly under attack. Now more than ever, we need legislation that protects the right to bodily autonomy, personal choice, and equitable access to healthcare. I refuse to stand by as our country devolves further and further into a nation where the right to choose is criminalized. As a member of the Pro-Choice Caucus and Democratic Women’s Caucus, I am proud to co-sponsor the Right to Contraception Act. = | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now. | = | = | = | = | = | = Until we pass a federal law protecting a woman’s right to choose, the horrific reality of our post-Roe world is not going anywhere. The Right to Contraception Act is essential to protecting an individual’s right to access contraceptives, and protecting their right to choose. I will never stop fighting for legislation that uplifts our future. I’m in this for the long haul, Peter. body:

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, Right on the heels of our historic endorsement from Abandon Harris, we’ve received the exciting news that The American Arab and Muslim Political Action Committee (AMPAC) has endorsed Stein/Ware!

---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/newad?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_18_early_pm&n=1)
---
Their endorsement statement is powerful and we want to share it in its entirety:

_“The American Arab and Muslim Political Action Committee (AMPAC) is pleased to announce its endorsement for the 2024 presidential election.__
__
__This year’s elections are exceptional and very challenging. In the past we have supported a candidate from one of the two major parties. This is an electoral cycle where AMPAC exercised the utmost patience and exhausted all means of dialogue, discussions, and conversation with the Harris campaign and the Trump campaign, to no avail.__
__
__The ongoing genocidal war against the occupied Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank and its extension to Lebanon has been the prime issue of concern to Muslim and Arab American voters. The community wants a ceasefire in Gaza and in Lebanon. Neither of the two campaigns promised a ceasefire. AMPAC could not endorse Harris or Trump.__
__
__We have decided to endorse the Green Party presidential candidate Dr. Jill Stein. We did not endorse Dr. Stein on account of her gender or faith. It is policies, priorities, and values that matter to us. Dr. Stein does not only support an immediate ceasefire, she is a principled candidate that supports peace and justice in the region. The Arab and Muslim vote is not in the pocket of any political party. We urge Arab and Muslim voters to support the candidate whose positions, values and priorities they support.”_ [**Peter, these important endorsements demonstrate that voters who reject both genocidal duopoly candidates are taking the red line to the ballot box with Stein/Ware. Can you dig deep today to help us get ads out all around the nation so that people know they have the choice to vote for the only anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency ticket of Stein/Ware?**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/newad?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fe_10_18_early_pm&n=2)_

body:
I'm back on the road post-Helene — but this time, it's different.
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95304764/506284760/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2155-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGMxOTgwNTAtNzA4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oVte5UJTOmJJZpLPjtu5HAIelaVG7LJBVz-By-LOr4k=)
It's great to be back in Florida’s communities again now that Hurricanes Milton and Helene have passed, friend — but I'd be lying if I said it felt no different than before. I spent some of last week in the Tampa Bay area, where over 3 million homes and businesses went without power, over 1,000 residents needed rescue from eight-foot storm surge and 18 inches of rainfall, and over two dozen more lost their lives as Milton made landfall as a Category 3 hurricane — all while still reeling from Helene’s impacts just two weeks prior.
As they now recover vital resources and rebuild their communities — _to the tune of billions in damages and disruption_ — I was proud to join efforts to distribute supplies and witness the resilience of my fellow Floridians.
The thing is this isn't our first big storm, and it won't be our last. It comes with the terrain, but there's no place we'd rather be.
So as the climate crisis worsens the effects of the already-extreme weather we're used to, the fact that GOP leaders would rather bury their heads in the sand isn't just dangerous — **it's infuriating.**
While visiting the homes of impacted residents, one thing that struck me during our talks was that they know it doesn't have to be this way.

They're sick of the status quo, and they're ready for elected officials to put Florida's people over profit-driven industry interests.

**But sadly, Rick Scott sold us out.**
From taking millions of dollars in donations from the same big oil and insurance companies that are ripping off Floridians, to slashing crucial water management and conservation jobs, **_to even repeatedly voting against billions of dollars for natural disaster relief_** — it all goes back, some way or another, to him.
**Now, we pay four times the national average for property insurance as worse disasters rip through year after year, while he and his corporate buddies line their pockets with our money and misery.

_Ya no más_.**
So Floridians will still be rebuilding come Nov. 5 — and they will remember at the ballot box. **And together, we will put an end to his rule.**
I'm in this race because, unlike Rick, I'm 100% committed to protecting Florida's families, environment, and animals against climate change. And in the Senate, I'll fight like hell to make our state's natural wonders as resilient as its people.
**But unless I reach my $500,000 goal by midnight tonight, I simply won't have the resources to take on Rick's massive fortune — let alone the millions in gifts from industries with a vested stake in keeping him in power.**
**_[So friend, will you please help me retire Rick Scott and keep up the fight for Florida's future in the U.S. Senate by rushing $5, $25, or anything you can right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95304766/506284761/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2155-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGMxOTgwNTAtNzA4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oVte5UJTOmJJZpLPjtu5HAIelaVG7LJBVz-By-LOr4k=)_**

clean_body: I'm back on the road post-Helene — but this time, it's different. | | | = It's great to be back in Florida’s communities again now that Hurricanes Milton and Helene have passed, friend — but I'd be lying if I said it felt no different than before. I spent some of last week in the Tampa Bay area, where over 3 million homes and businesses went without power, over 1,000 residents needed rescue from eight-foot storm surge and 18 inches of rainfall, and over two dozen more lost their lives as Milton made landfall as a Category 3 hurricane — all while still reeling from Helene’s impacts just two weeks prior. As they now recover vital resources and rebuild their communities — to the tune of billions in damages and disruption — I was proud to join efforts to distribute supplies and witness the resilience of my fellow Floridians. The thing is this isn't our first big storm, and it won't be our last. It comes with the terrain, but there's no place we'd rather be. So as the climate crisis worsens the effects of the already-extreme weather we're used to, the fact that GOP leaders would rather bury their heads in the sand isn't just dangerous — it's infuriating. While visiting the homes of impacted residents, one thing that struck me during our talks was that they know it doesn't have to be this way. They're sick of the status quo, and they're ready for elected officials to put Florida's people over profit-driven industry interests. But sadly, Rick Scott sold us out. From taking millions of dollars in donations from the same big oil and insurance companies that are ripping off Floridians, to slashing crucial water management and conservation jobs, to even repeatedly voting against billions of dollars for natural disaster relief — it all goes back, some way or another, to him. Now, we pay four times the national average for property insurance as worse disasters rip through year after year, while he and his corporate buddies line their pockets with our money and misery. Ya no más. So Floridians will still be rebuilding come Nov. 5 — and they will remember at the ballot box. And together, we will put an end to his rule. I'm in this race because, unlike Rick, I'm 100% committed to protecting Florida's families, environment, and animals against climate change. And in the Senate, I'll fight like hell to make our state's natural wonders as resilient as its people. But unless I reach my $500,000 goal by midnight tonight, I simply won't have the resources to take on Rick's massive fortune — let alone the millions in gifts from industries with a vested stake in keeping him in power. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = If you've read this far, thanks for sticking around and for all you do. Florida strong. Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: these kids are everywhere!
body:
Dear Peter,

If you’ve seen my recent emails, then you know that I’ve been shining as much of the spotlight as I can on Students for Life Action’s dedicated student leaders.

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NWrchkdbh2D-hw3RU1NMSQ~~/AAVkMwA~-xAOJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
That’s because the work they do for us is invaluable.

Just this past weekend, students we deployed to the Concord and Elizabeth City areas of North Carolina knocked on over 4,500 doors to inform voters about the stakes in November!

Not only that, but THIS upcoming weekend we’re deploying 100 students to Orlando, Florida, and dozens more to St. Charles, Missouri to do the same!

Only this time, our students will be urging voters to vote NO on radical abortion referendums.

And to wrap up our Florida deployment, our students will be hoisting the massive banner pictured below over the busiest overpass in Orlando to expose as many voters to the Abortion Lobby’s sick agenda as possible!

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_X9w4fUTlJEZ7NUfLjogww~~/AAVkMwA~-xAOJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA

But while our students are eager to help us out in any way they can, that doesn’t mean this kind of work is easy.

After all, getting doors slammed in your face is maddening.

And having the cops called on you for no reason, being attacked, and even chased down the street isn’t exactly fun either.

But if these young students knew they had the full support of good folks like you, Peter, it would all be worth it.

So, if you’d like to chip in to help our student leaders – even if it’s just helping buy their lunch – I’m sure they’d be very grateful
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/X7TMWKrvCH1pOw6BaVmAfg~~/AAVkMwA~-xAOJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
!

With the 2024 Elections in less than a month, I want to take every opportunity I can to highlight the fantastic young people in the Pro-Life Movement and the work they do.

And of course, I want to thank you for being one of our supporters I know I can count on to support them through thick and thin.

Even if it just meant buying them lunch from time to time
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/tU2wD8NX0xQdhwDpI-2b0A~~/AAVkMwA~-xAOJSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
.

Be sure to keep an eye out as we get closer to the election, as we’ve got even more deployments coming up soon.

And thanks for everything you do for these young students, Peter!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action
