body:
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308237/506295079/158001685?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=) Friend,

I am running to serve CA-30, but that never meant I was going to step away from my work in the Assembly. Others may have made campaigning their full-time job, but I was elected to make change for the better, and I never stopped.

I'm proud to share that this work has paid off, with many of my bills from this year’s session having been signed into law over the past month.

Here are just a few that were signed which I’m proud of: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308238/506295081/158001685?refcode=em-10.18.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=) **Paraquat Evaluation (AB 1963)** triggers an immediate reevaluation of paraquat, a powerful and widely used weedkiller that has been linked to Parkinson’s disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, childhood leukemia, and other serious health issues. Paraquat is already banned in more than 60 countries, including those with large agricultural economies including the United Kingdom, China, Brazil and the members of the European Union, yet California remains the top user of the spray in our nation. Finally the State will be compelled to better protect farm workers and nearby communities. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308239/506295082/158001685?refcode=em-10.18.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=) **Wetlands Forever (AB 2875)** protects California’s precious and dwindling wetlands from the Sackett Decision, a recent Supreme Court ruling which dismantled protections for our nation’s wetlands. Our wetlands provide 60% of our state’s drinking water, and they are critical habitat for our state's native species and serve as natural barriers protecting us from flooding. They are not for sale. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308241/506295084/158001685?refcode=em-10.18.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=) **Ending Sexual Assault on College Campuses (AB 810)** , helps prevent predatory professors and coaches credibly accused of harassment or sexual assault from being hired at new campuses and endangering new students. Sexual impropriety should never mar what should be some of the best years of young adults’ lives, and now we are one step closer to ensuring it won’t. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308242/506295086/158001685?refcode=em-10.18.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=) **Protecting Tenants (AB 2801)** helps stop illegal security deposit retentions that can harm renters’ financial well-being. Security deposits can be prohibitively expensive, and tenants’ ability to get them back can vary from landlord to landlord. Responsible tenants deserve to get their deposits back. The law will also help landlords more easily prove actual damage. The clarity and process AB 2801 establishes will help both tenants and landlords. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308243/506295088/158001685?refcode=em-10.18.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=) **Funding Transit (AB 761)** will help California compete for federal tax dollars which could provide billions of dollars to LA Metro’s K Line and other much-needed projects throughout the state to address transportation, housing, and climate change.

I will never stop bringing the fight for the well-being of our community – in our district, and in Washington. But working to get these and other bills passed has meant less time campaigning, and that is where I hope you can help:

[**With less than three weeks to the election, there’s no time to waste. If you’re able, please donate $3 today to help ensure we bring proven, effective leadership to Washington.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95308244/506295090/158001685?refcode=em-10.18.24-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzBiMDMyZjYtNzM4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=RGUwTrsaPY_7TaU9ikHhegfAvyCAAbMNhz5YwHgAdMc=)

Thank you,

clean_body: | = Friend, I am running to serve CA-30, but that never meant I was going to step away from my work in the Assembly. Others may have made campaigning their full-time job, but I was elected to make change for the better, and I never stopped. I'm proud to share that this work has paid off, with many of my bills from this year’s session having been signed into law over the past month. Here are just a few that were signed which I’m proud of: = Paraquat Evaluation (AB 1963) triggers an immediate reevaluation of paraquat, a powerful and widely used weedkiller that has been linked to Parkinson’s disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, childhood leukemia, and other serious health issues. Paraquat is already banned in more than 60 countries, including those with large agricultural economies including the United Kingdom, China, Brazil and the members of the European Union, yet California remains the top user of the spray in our nation. Finally the State will be compelled to better protect farm workers and nearby communities. = Wetlands Forever (AB 2875) protects California’s precious and dwindling wetlands from the Sackett Decision, a recent Supreme Court ruling which dismantled protections for our nation’s wetlands. Our wetlands provide 60% of our state’s drinking water, and they are critical habitat for our state's native species and serve as natural barriers protecting us from flooding. They are not for sale. = Ending Sexual Assault on College Campuses (AB 810) , helps prevent predatory professors and coaches credibly accused of harassment or sexual assault from being hired at new campuses and endangering new students. Sexual impropriety should never mar what should be some of the best years of young adults’ lives, and now we are one step closer to ensuring it won’t. = Protecting Tenants (AB 2801) helps stop illegal security deposit retentions that can harm renters’ financial well-being. Security deposits can be prohibitively expensive, and tenants’ ability to get them back can vary from landlord to landlord. Responsible tenants deserve to get their deposits back. The law will also help landlords more easily prove actual damage. The clarity and process AB 2801 establishes will help both tenants and landlords. = Funding Transit (AB 761) will help California compete for federal tax dollars which could provide billions of dollars to LA Metro’s K Line and other much-needed projects throughout the state to address transportation, housing, and climate change. I will never stop bringing the fight for the well-being of our community – in our district, and in Washington. But working to get these and other bills passed has meant less time campaigning, and that is where I hope you can help: = Thank you, Laura If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | **= | = ---|--- = | = = | =** | | Paid for by Laura Friedman for Congress Laura's campaign doesn't take a dime from corporate PACs and completely relies on grassroots supporters like you! That’s why I’m running to replace Kevin Cramer who accepts money from pharmaceutical companies and votes AGAINST lowering prescription drug prices for our seniors.

I need 415 gifts before midnight to fund my people-powered campaign and compete with Cramer’s deep pockets. Can you rush $15 before midnight to help? Anything you can spare makes a world of difference. >>_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95309487/506298642/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20241018_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDZiZGRhMmYtNzU4ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=f-FPJxnF_CoaAUaJ4VauAihY50wRbZ9jM75nKfB8P9U=)

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

And Republicans have even gone as far as to [block a bill to protect access to contraception](https://substack.com/redirect/21369cf3-3503-4166-8e56-9b5d92815d04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). We cannot afford to remain uninformed on this critical issue.

---|---|---
_Demonstrators march at an abortion rights rally in Orlando on June 27, 2022._ **Stephen M. Dowell/Orlando Sentinel/Tribune News Service via Getty**
### Red State Increase in Infant Deaths
A [Johns Hopkins study reports that in 2022](https://substack.com/redirect/61df4a20-bb9f-41b0-ad48-c6cab5abd211?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Texas abortion ban enacted by S.B. 8 led to 216 _additional_ infant deaths. This ban was despite [Texas already suffering the worst rate of infant mortality in the developed world](https://substack.com/redirect/4a93cc01-3e6b-4311-8e52-8695b1ee700e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And sadly, Texas is not alone. GOP led states that ban abortion and reproductive health access top the list in infant mortality. As the CDC data below shows, we can make a direct correlation and causation between denial of reproductive health and increase in infant mortality.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5df4abaf-d7d7-4ad4-b4ef-07d00d760c91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b100222-7e3a-47c4-8444-90625c2a8efd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Keep these charts in mind when you hear Republicans talk about "sending abortion back to the states." In doing so, politicians are dooming children in red states to death. And in their draconian attempts to control women, Republicans are also killing women in record numbers.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dmFaiuidUxkUjsygeQLRhb9VywksLZMBzoxRvmaNeaw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150410189)
### Historic Rise in Red State Maternal Deaths
Northwestern University reports that maternal mortality has nearly doubled over the last decade, and is rapidly increasing post Roe--especially in red states. The study published in the American Journal of Preventative Medicine, [found](https://substack.com/redirect/690cc488-8c05-41e9-bc9d-ced350f08c00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Between 2014 and 2021, the overall maternal mortality rates in the U.S. nearly doubled, from 16.5 to 31.8, with the largest increase of 18.9 to 31.8 occurring from 2019 to 2021.
Another study by The Commonwealth Fund found similar and equally horrifying data, and added the massive racial impact of MAGA abortion bans, [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/0b661c4f-f350-4d03-a200-f0d796101925?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> We found that maternal death rates were 62% higher in 2020 in abortion-restriction states than in abortion-access states (28.8 vs. 17.8 per 100,000 births). **Notably, across the three years presented, the maternal mortality rate was increasing nearly twice as fast in states with abortion restrictions.** Maternal deaths are high in the U.S. relative to other high-income countries, and there are significant inequities by race and ethnicity.[8](https://substack.com/redirect/c82becf2-2c2d-45ad-8eb4-c42a9f25d207?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) In addition, **for every major racial or ethnic group, maternal death rates are higher in abortion-restriction states compared to abortion-access states** , including 20% higher among non-Hispanic Black people, 33% higher among non-Hispanic white people, and 31% higher among Hispanic people.
So not only have MAGA abortion bans caused a near doubling of maternal deaths, leaving children orphaned, spouses widowed, and families destroyed, they've further exacerbated the maternal death crisis for Black and Latino women. The Northwestern University study also reports that, "_maternal deaths are largely preventable_." This means that the vast majority of maternal deaths pre repeal of Roe, and virtually all maternal deaths post Roe were preventable--but horrific anti-science and anti-family GOP policies ensured and expedited these preventable deaths.
And now despite new data on the devastating impact MAGA abortion bans have on women who suffer rape, the GOP responds only by doubling down on abortion bans.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dmFaiuidUxkUjsygeQLRhb9VywksLZMBzoxRvmaNeaw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150410189)
### Impregnated by Rape -- A Rapidly Increasing Crisis
The Journal of American Medical Association ("JAMA") reports a shocking fact. In the 14 Republican led states that banned abortion access, 134 women are impregnated by rape daily. Yes, **daily.** [The JAMA doctors report that an:](https://substack.com/redirect/0fe7b866-2483-4f07-a666-853884ee57c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
> Estimated 519,981 survivors of completed rape experienced 64,565 rape-related pregnancies during the 4 to 18 months that bans were in effect.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c33685f9-3d97-4761-84a2-f6dfa770a1eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
You'll notice Texas is by far #1 in rapes in the 14 states that have banned abortion. But how is this possible when Texas Governor Abbot famously said he would "[eliminate all rapists](https://substack.com/redirect/8ed7a811-edad-439f-98e8-1fa677713d02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in Texas? (_heavy sarcasm_). Making matters all the worse is that [several states allow rapists who impregnate a woman to later sue her for child custody rights](https://substack.com/redirect/3fa67179-5839-47c7-98bc-305a3e100c77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In reality, Abbot has empowered rapists to continue assaulting women with impunity. Meanwhile, Donald Trump continues to brag about ending Roe, even calling it "a beautiful thing."

### Conclusion
The horrific and painful deaths of Black women like [Amber Thurman](https://substack.com/redirect/5e66a45e-1b8e-4cda-b82b-484f9e2bf306?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were not inevitable. They were the result of deliberate policy choices by extremist MAGA Republicans who care more about controlling women than they do actually listening to healthcare professionals about medical science.
Every medical and academic institution reports that banning abortion is killing women, killing babies, and all while empowering rapists. Yet the GOP doubles down at every opportunity. The fact is that for Republicans, it was never about life--it was always about control of women. In reality, this is fascism and has the potential to devastate our entire society if not stopped on November 5.

Friend, Yesterday was the last debate between my opponent and me. It was hosted by a local TV station and their host, the very fair Laurel Porter. Before we got started, my campaign manager asked to snap a photo, and I believe this perfectly captures the state of the race: As you can see, I'm in great spirits. Every time I get to share my common-sense policies and expose my opponent's persistent betrayal of our values, more voters come to my side. My opponent, however, did not appear to be looking forward to our debate. And why would she? How can she be happy to defend a record of voting to keep a border open that's resulting in the death of her constituents from the illegal migrants and fentanyl it brings across? What's to smile about when you've voted to erase women's sports and allow men to invade their protected spaces? The comfort of raising nearly $1 million in corporate donations and lying about it can't overcome the dread of being told the truth about your record of failure during a televised debate. Do you feel as optimistic about this race right now as I do? The only cause my opponent has for optimism is that she has a huge fundraising edge thanks to corporate PAC money and Democrat groups funding her campaign. Take a look at this chart to see how badly I'm being outspent. (The blue columns represent Democrat spending, the red columns represent Republican spending.) Pretty crazy, right? But you can do something about it. Make a contribution today to help me win this race at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/Ig6Q763oplgdfjyzXfPRSkmg/nJ5dWcEuO3u0sWA64LznWw). We're coming down to the wire, and your opportunity to help is slipping away. I'd appreciate anything you can spare. Respectfully,
Joe Kent [](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/WatBNYmtxt95RlFC151o2Q/nJ5dWcEuO3u0sWA64LznWw) _Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund_

body:

#

Extremists and corporate lobbyists spending bundles of out-of-state corporate dollars in support of my opponent in the race for Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court. They’ve been texting you. Mailing you. Anything to harass you into thinking I’m somebody other than who I am.
They even spell my name wrong.
---
[](https://lynchformontana.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=179e5534b0fac3e64994314a9&id=d8a9d78d3d&e=9e9e92f018)
| My opponent is a tool of the out-of-state corporate lobbyists who are funding and runI want your vote and support to be Montana’s next Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court to be sure we have leadership of the judicial branch who cares about and will protect the Constitutional rights of all Montanans. I’m a champion of the 1972 Montana State Constitution, and will fight off efforts to undermine your Constitutional rights and those of all Montanans to privacy, access to public lands, public education, and many more. I am running to make sure that our highest court works for us, not out-of-staters and far-right extremists who want to impose their will on all of us.
---
[SUPPORT NOW](https://lynchformontana.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=179e5534b0fac3e64994314a9&id=dbcff54b67&e=9e9e92f018)

[**The lobbyists are trying to take over the Montana Supreme Court with their millionsof dollars. I’m asking you and other to chip in $50, $100, or even $200 today and help us beat back this threat. Left alone, they can probably beat me. With your help and the support of thousands of others, we can win and protect Montana’s judicial branch and our Constitutional rights.**](https://lynchformontana.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=179e5534b0fac3e64994314a9&id=44c89ad23a&e=9e9e92f018) We can win this together. Please do what you can to help push me over the finish line with a victory.

**Best,**
**Judge Jerry Lynch**

CBS: Eligible voters are being swept up in conservative activists' efforts to purge voter rolls [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101824_2&amount=25]
Team: We're hearing from allies on the ground that up to 500,000 Georgians are at risk of having their voter registration “purged” before Election Day.
Partisan election officials conduct mass registered voter removals, as required by recent Georgia voter suppression laws -- laws that include limits on mail-in ballots, the criminalization of giving out water to voters waiting in line, and so much more.
T hese purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . Multiple stories written by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution in recent years have highlighted wrongfully purged voters and show the evidence clearly.
This comes after groups based outside of Georgia brought massed challenges against almost 400,000 Georgia voters in the 2022 general election and runoff. That doesn't include the 92,000 additional challenges brought in Georgia by amateur " voter fraud hunters " who believe the lies peddled by partisan activists trying to shake our faith in our elections and guarantee their party wins elections.
Voter suppression is real, Team, both in Georgia and across the country. Push back on these cynical purges and voter challenges with $25 or whatever you can today to protect the right to vote nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101824_2&amount=25]

So what we do in these final 18 days really matters,
Peter, because whether we win or
lose will be determined by how many voters we can reach during this final
stretch.

Your support has never been more critical than it is right
now, Peter, because
with Early Voting starting in less than a week and Senate control on the

name: Carolina at United We Dream Action
subject: Let’s make one thing clear
body:
Our lives could change on any day with no warning. | | | Peter, ever since we first won DACA 12 years ago, we’ve had to fight to defend it — one court case after another. This moment is no different, as the Fifth Circuit Court held its hearing on the case that could shut down DACA one week ago — and a decision can come _at any time._ Every day that passes is another day that DACA recipients live in limbo, unable to plan for the future. We don’t know when the decision will come, and we don’t know for sure what it will be. **But there’s no need to wait to take action.** We’re using the urgency of this moment to demand lawmakers finally provide permanent protections — a pathway to citizenship and not just band-aid solutions. Through it all, we have not forgotten that DACA was never meant to be more than a temporary solution. Let’s make this clear: **DACA was never enough ❌ — and we need permanent protections now! ✅** UWDA is leading the charge to secure an inclusive, expansive pathway to citizenship by taking our demands to elected officials in Congress and the Biden administration. name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: Who is Shawn Harris?
body:
| | | | |
---
Friend –
Many people have been asking me... **_Who is Shawn Harris?_**
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_Shawn Harris: My propped up Democrat opponent_
Shawn Harris is a _**radical Democrat, masquerading as a moderate**_ , who was recruited by the Democrat establishment and even some fake “Republicans” to **_defeat me_** this November...
In his own words:
**“We're building a coalition from across the country,**
**united in our goal to**** __unseat Marjorie Taylor Greene__****.”**
** _\- Shawn Harris_**
[DEFEND MTG](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Make no mistake: Democrats are dumping TENS OF MILLIONS of dollars in the battleground states like Georgia.
They have a MASSIVE war chest being used to crush downballot races across the state like mine.
**And Democrats will spend MILLIONS of dollars against me like they always have to suppress Republican turnout, which hurts President Trump’s chances of winning Georgia.**
If that happens, we lose the state of Georgia.
[DEFEND MTG](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Shawn Harris has referred to me as “Moscow Marge,” because I opposed shipping _**your tax dollars overseas**_ while our border is wide open, and _**Americans _desperately_ need that money here at home**_.
When Shawn Harris _**lies to the public**_ and claims that I am some sort of Russian agent just because I don’t believe we should be fighting wars that have _**nothing to do with us**_ , he is flirting with ideas that _**could get me killed**_.
How do I know? Because Ryan Routhe, the latest lunatic to attempt to murder President Trump was _**radicalized to do so**_ because of his love for Ukraine...
That isn’t the only example of Shawn Harris lying about me, or my record... But that’s the kind of rhetoric that has led to the h _**ighest amount of death threats against me and my family...**_
It isn’t that Shawn Harris doesn’t know what the consequences of his actions might be...
**_It’s that radical Democrat consultants, their handlers, and their Candidates like Shawn Harris _just don’t care_._**
They didn’t care when **violent BLM rioters** burnt the entire country down in 2020...
They didn’t care when there were **two assassination attempts** against President Trump...
They didn’t care when **pro-Hamas rioters shut down the Capitol**...
In fact,_** it was all part of the plan of The Democrat Party of Violence**_.
[STAND UP TO RADICAL VIOLENT DEMOCRATS](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
When I said that the US should stand with Israel - one of our longest standing allies - before standing with Ukraine - Shawn Harris called me an “anti-Semite” (a word he clearly doesn’t know the definition of) and again accused me of working for Putin:
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Friend, it is no secret that I am the biggest thorn in the side of the Deep State Controlled Democrats, and gutless, weak RINO “Republicans...”
There is a reason that now, with **less than a month to go before the election, Democrats are _propping up a candidate with _NO POLICIES_ other than complaining about _me_ , calling me names that could get me _murdered_ , and trying to popularize sending more money out of our country._**
If we lose our House majority this November, and the likes of Shawn Harris and other Deep State funded, phony candidates flood into our government... **_Even if President Trump wins, the fight will be lost. _**
[DEFEND MTG - DEFEND AMERICA](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I don’t want that to be our reality...
I want to secure victory for President Trump, and guarantee the House is full of Members of Congress that will __**support his Agenda 47**__ , **__secure the border__** , _**_protect the 1st & 2nd Amendments_**_, **_and stop the_** _**_endless foreign wars_**_** _!_**
But if we allow the left to flip seats like mine and crush one of the biggest opponents to the Radical Left, I’m afraid none of that will happen...
The stakes are too high for **the DNC** and **their pawns** to install **a puppet Member of Congress in _my seat_** , **create more chaos** , **undermine President Trump** , **get us tied up in more wars** , and _**leave the Southern Border open**_**!**
There is a reason that the DNC is choosing _**me**_ to hit with this, and not some other member: They know what a threat I am to them.
I’m getting nervous, and to be honest... _**I need your help...**_
__**[I’m fighting tooth-and-nail against this new development... But I can’t do it alone...](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**__
__**[Are you with me](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**__ _**?**_
_Yours Sincerely,_
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Marjorie Taylor Greene
[](https://go.vbtrc.com/r/9gFz/?__vbtrk=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjU0MTQ1OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

| | Peter, I’ve heard a lot of politicians talk about “defending our country” and “fighting for freedom.”

_But it’s ironic: most of them have never lifted a finger for anyone but themselves._

I’m sick of career politicians driving our great country down the gutter. It’s time for something different.

**My name is Hung Cao. I’m a 25-year Navy veteran, LEGAL immigrant, and candidate for the U.S. Senate in Virginia.** Unlike most politicians today, I’ve actually seen what it’s like to fight for freedom. As a Navy Captain, I went to some of the most dangerous war zones in the world like Iraq, Afghanistan and Somalia fighting terrorists in face-to-face combat.
---

| | | | A lot of folks probably don’t know this, folks, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families. She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service. I often refer to her as “ _my quintessential big sister_ ,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._ And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Let’s talk about Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Ruben needs our help to win against Kari Lake. She’s got billionaires and millionaires backing her up, along with Trump and the entire MAGA Right.
#
Friend, hi. This is Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
In just a minute, I’m going to ask you to split a donation with Ruben Gallego’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona.
Before I do, please. Let me explain why that donation is so, so important today:
Most lawmakers have no idea what it’s like working paycheck to paycheck, or trying to pay rent working a low wage job.
When I first ran for Congress, I worked as a bartender and lived on tips. I know that stress because I lived it.
That goes for Ruben, too. He grew up sleeping on the floor of the apartment he shared with his mom and three sisters. That’s all they could afford.
He worked every job you can think of to support his family, to get through school and then college. We both went into public service because we wanted to improve things for working families. We felt a responsibility to our friends, our families, our communities.
Ruben carries those people with him everywhere he goes, but he also takes the next step.
He gets results for them. He wins.
This time, Ruben needs our help to win against Kari Lake. She’s got billionaires and millionaires backing her up, along with Trump and the entire MAGA Right. The race is neck-and-neck, and they aren’t backing down. But Ruben’s got a shot because of grassroots supporters like you.
He relies on small-dollar donations, the same way I do. And that’s why I’m asking you, humbly, to help him out if you can.
[ Support Ruben by splitting a donation between our campaign for progress and Ruben's campaign for U.S. Senate. They’ll put whatever you can give to work in these final weeks ahead of election day.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20241018-gallego.bCX6W3&refcode=em20241018-7403-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7403%2E2526796%2E8ml_I0)

Thank you,
Alexandria

subject: Protecting Title IX – Support Our Campaign Today
body:
| | | | | | | |

| | | |
---
| | | **Protecting Title IX – Support Our Campaign Today****!**
---

Dear Peter,
Title IX was established to ensure equal opportunities for women and girls in education and sports, protecting fairness and leveling the playing field for future generations. But today, these protections are under threat. Radical changes are being proposed that undermine the very foundation of Title IX, jeopardizing the rights of female athletes and students across Washington’s 8th Congressional District and beyond.

Carmen Goers was moved by a story of a middle school runner here in Washington who qualified for the regional championship and lost to a biologically male runner competing in the girls' race. This brave young lady shared her story of disappointment, bullying, and threats when she protested. As a former athlete and mother of female athletes, Carmen will fight to protect female athletes and the intent of Title IX.

We believe in safeguarding fairness in sports, defending the integrity of women’s athletics, and ensuring that every student can pursue their education without being marginalized.

---
| | | |
---
|
But we need your help to keep fighting. Your contribution will allow us to amplify our message, reach more voters, and advocate for policies that protect the original intent of Title IX.
Whether it’s $25, $50, or any amount, your donation will make a significant impact in this critical battle.

---

The photo below is of the actual ballot sent to me and yes, that's my name on the ballot. I just voted for myself so I should have at least one vote when the tallies are done. Three if Mom and Dad pull through.

Why is there no party affiliation by my name even though I'm a Conservative Republican? Because I'm running unaffiliated with any party this time. The broader question is why I did that. In short, it took me so long to decide to run that I had missed some deadlines to run with the Republican party, and running as unaffiliated was the next best option.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/61c52ca6-b770-4135-a0d2-e93130cf06e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Vote for Tyler Murset
Some people have accused me of hiding my party affiliation like I'm trying to deceive the public. That is not the case. I am not the Republican nominee so I didn't feel it would be ethical to lead with that.
Anyway, on to more fun matters...
I've begun developing an app which I'm calling VotingAct. As a reminder, I'm creating the app so that you can tell me how to vote on bills. I will vote with the majority.
I had a false start and hired a guy online to create the app who resides on the East Coast. That did not work out, and I spent a fair amount of money on it before pulling the plug. I will chalk that up to a learning experience.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3599ca2d-27bc-41bd-af62-1d4e1575cdb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
VotingAct. In the app stores soon!

Serendipitously, a gentleman who attends church with my parents teaches app development for a local college and my Dad connected us. He lined me up with a couple of new hungry graduates to help build the project and we're in the production process. We have a basic framework that we're putting together. The app will be secure and encrypted. The votes and voter rolls will be public but anonymized. Details will follow soon as to how we will do that.
After the first failed attempt at the app, I feel much better about it this time and the foundations for the app will be better and cost less money in the long run.
Here's my latest campaign video which I've been advertising on Facebook. It has tens of thousands of views and quite a few comments. Check it out if you haven't seen it yet and please share this post with people.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9d05a8cc-c6df-4572-b966-78d25cab5ad1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
You may ask why I'm building the voting app at all when the probability is high that the incumbent will win the race. It is because I'm not stopping here and if I don't win this time I plan on challenging the holder of the seat as a Republican next time. I also plan on recruiting others to run on the same platform. We'll design the app so that pretty much any public office will be covered and constituents who belong to those areas can use the app to direct their elected officials. Having a downloadable working app will help spread my message.
If you live in my district, please vote for me. If you don't live in my district, please help me share my message. I don't think the people are represented by their government. We can make a change we just have to come together to do that.
Tyler Murset

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hi! I’m Tara, Tim Kaine’s Virginia Finance Director.
You might have seen the news that last night, notable cat lady Taylor Swift endorsed Kamala Harris and Tim Walz for the White House
Taylor and I actually have a lot in common. I, too, am a proud cat lady who supports Kamala and Tim (and the other Tim — Kaine, that is!)
This is me with my cats, Ada (named after computer science pioneer Ada Lovelace) and Nikola (named after inventor and engineer Nikola Tesla), and Taylor with one of her three cats, Benjamin Button.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Contrary to what JD Vance thinks, neither Taylor Swift nor I are actually miserable! Nor do we think we deserve less of a voice in our democracy than any other American — unlike Vance.
(Seriously — JD Vance has said in multiple recently resurfaced interviews that he thinks the Democratic Party is being run by “miserable childless cat ladies” and that people without kids have less of a stake in our country and should have less of a voice. Oh, and he thinks we should pay more taxes. Like, what?)
At first glance, those comments are so absurd that they’re funny.
But the thing is, he’s not joking.
And when someone who’s in the running to be our nation’s next Vice President says stuff like this, we have to listen to what he’s really saying. Here’s my best attempt at a translation:
Women have to be married and have kids to be happy and functioning members of our society. We should define who gets to vote based on their parental status. Cats are bad (??!!).
Meanwhile, he’s also trying to take control of how people become parents in the first place, with positions that threaten to limit both IVF and birth control, not to mention other reproductive care.
If you’ve read this far and you agree that we can’t let JD Vance anywhere near the Vice Presidency, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to our campaign here in Virginia. We’re working around the clock to make sure VA’s 13 electoral votes go to Kamala Harris, not the Trump-Vance ticket — and that we can re-elect Tim Kaine to the U.S. Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=20]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024?express_lane=true&amount=250]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Look, everyone is entitled to their own views. You don’t like cats? Fine! But what you don’t get to do — especially when you’re in the running to lead this country! — is tell the American people that their personal reproductive choices make them less a part of our democracy. That’s just BS.
I’m all in to stop JD Vance from becoming our next Vice President, and I’m so proud that our team here in Virginia is building a massive voter outreach program to mobilize Democrats in every corner of the Commonwealth.
When we vote, we win — so if you can, please chip in to help us reach and turn out more voters! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thanks so much.
-Tara

Friend --
An open Senate seat in Michigan is a rare opportunity. That's why Republicans are doing everything they can to win this swing seat and control of the Senate.
**I’m running for Senate because we need a new generation of leaders who think differently, work harder, and _never forget_ that we are public servants.** Being of service to the American people means bringing passionate, pragmatic leadership to Washington.
Service is something I’ve done my entire adult life -- first in the CIA, where I served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military, and later at the White House, State Department, and finally at the Pentagon, as an appointee of President Obama. Thanks to people like you, I’ve served two full terms in Congress, winning three extremely competitive elections in a Republican district.

I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president attack me personally. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.
Folks,
I don’t know if I’ll ever get used to watching a former president come after me. I grew up with next to nothing and one of the most powerful people in the world just calls me out at his rallies.
That’s always going to be weird to me.
But that’s what Donald Trump did when he came here in August. Again in September. On social media earlier this week. And again, this week, in Arizona.
He came back because Arizona is critical to his chances this year, and winning this state is personal for him after we beat him back in 2020.
He knows if he can help defeat me he’s got an open path to the White House. He’s got to go through us to win.
That raises the stakes of our campaign beyond just one seat in the U.S. Senate, and beyond our Senate Majority. This race is about beating Trump, once and for all.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: I will never apologize for this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I can't stop thinking about this moment during my debate with my opponent last week, and I want to talk to you about it.
Let me set the stage: About halfway through the forum, we were asked about reproductive rights. I said, as I often do, that it’s a hugely important issue for voters, and as a 35-year-old woman, it’s personal to me. I said that having autonomy over your body is a basic freedom that we absolutely need to protect.
My opponent didn't feel the same. He reminded us that he's pro-life – which is, of course, his right. But then he said, rather disingenuously, that Californians’ rights aren’t at stake right now.
That's wrong. Let’s be completely clear: Republicans in the House have already introduced legislation to implement a national abortion ban – and most of their conference has signed on to it. If they gain control of Congress and pass that bill, it will override any state abortion protections, including constitutional protections. Here in California, our rights are on the line, too.
But that exchange isn't what bothered me most during our debate – though it was, of course, outrageous. It was towards the very end when my opponent essentially said I should stop talking about abortion and start talking about "real issues."
I’m sorry if Bill Wells doesn’t understand this, but for tens of millions of people, reproductive care is at the center of our health care. When and whether to have a child is one of the most important decisions we will ever make, and has a massive impact on our futures, including our economic futures.
I will never apologize for treating reproductive health care like the kitchen table issue that it is.
The fact that my opponent doesn’t get this is just one more reason he’s not fit to represent our district in Congress.
I know you’re with me on this issue. I’ve heard time and time again – from people of all genders, by the way! – that this is incredibly important to them, and that they’re counting on Democrats to flip the House this November and protect our rights.
So today, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to my re-election campaign so I can defeat my anti-choice opponent and ensure that Congress protects reproductive rights and freedoms. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Thank you so much for your support.
-Sara

And although Miller-Meeks has changed her address to a Scott County residence, which is in the 1st District, many have reason to believe she doesn’t hang out there much. = = One LeClaire resident even made a formal request to the Congressional Ethics Office regarding the matter. And that’s not all – in her latest FEC filing, on a loan Miller-Meeks made to her own campaign, she lists her Ottumwa address... which, again, is in Iowa’s 3rd Congressional District. = How can someone effectively lead and understand our local issues if they don't even live here and experience them firsthand? | | _**Keeping Our Foot on the Gas!**_
---
Friends, We are coming off the energy of an incredible State Dinner, where Republicans from all corners of our great state came together to celebrate our shared values. Indiana legend Lou Holtz left us all inspired with his words, and it was a fantastic opportunity to connect with so many passionate Hoosiers who are committed to keeping Indiana strong.

But the real work is still ahead of us! The Freedom & Opportunity Bus Tour is hitting the road this weekend in Northern Indiana, and this is where grassroots energy makes the difference. We need volunteers at every stop to help knock on doors, make phone calls, and connect with voters face-to-face. It’s these personal conversations that win elections! If you can't make it to the tour stops, you can still play a huge part by organizing local phone banks or neighborhood canvassing efforts. The flyer below has all the information on our tour stops, and we’re here to support you in making a local impact.

Also, don’t forget – Mike Braun, our Republican nominee for Governor, will be stepping onto the debate stage on Thursday, October 24th. Mike Braun represents the conservative leadership that will continue to move Indiana forward, and we’re counting on you to spread the word and rally support ahead of this critical debate.

In addition to volunteering, we need every Republican to VOTE EARLY and encourage your neighbors and friends to do the same! Every vote cast ahead of Election Day helps secure our victories across the state. Let’s build momentum by turning out early and strong!

Lastly, we’re gearing up for an exciting Election Night Watch Party at the JW Marriott on November 5th. Details will follow, but mark your calendars and join us for a night of celebration and hard-earned victory! Thank you all for what you do!
---

_**"Vote Yes"!!**_
---
Many of you are likely aware that the Democratic party is currently running a "vote no" campaign against our three Republican appointed Indiana Supreme Court justices that are up for retention on this November's ballot. It is extremely important that we get as many of our Republican friends and families to vote "yes" on this retention vote.
---
Here is Why:
* These Justices were appointed by Republican Governors - Gov. Mitch Daniels and Gov. Eric Holcomb.
* Democrats are attempting to use the Indiana Supreme Court's decision to uphold the Indiana abortion ban as a way to push a "No" retention vote on Chief Justice Loretta Rush, Justice Mark Massa, and Justice Derek Molter.
* They are using this retention vote campaign to boost turnout for their down ballot candidates, including Jennifer McCormick, Destiny Wells, and others on the ballot.
* While these Justices have served on our Supreme Court we have seen continued progress for conservative values.

---
This court is experienced, with impeccable reputations for fairness and impartiality, upholds the constitution and interprets the law as written, maintains honesty and integrity in our justice system, and protects the important role the Judiciary plays in our constitutionally divided government. We urge you to take your friends and family to the polls, and tell your network of voters that we need to make sure we vote "yes" to retaining these three key members of our Supreme Court.

body:
Things are turning against us in Arizona and if we don’t get a handle on it quickly this could go south way faster than anyone expects.
#

Peter — do us a favor and don't scroll away just yet.
Things are turning against us in Arizona and if we don’t get a handle on it quickly this could go south way faster than anyone expects. Please, let us explain:
**FIRST:** Over the last week or so we’ve seen Kari Lake start to claw back voters in the polls. We were leading handily for a while but that lead has started to shrink, and now it’s getting way too close for comfort.
**THEN:** We started looking into the data, specifically early ballot returns. Republicans are absolutely wrecking us so far. They’re turning out at a much higher rate than Democrats. If it continues this way much longer it could be a disaster for our chances.
**NOW:** We’ve got to rally, and fast. About 80% of the voters in Arizona turn in their ballots either by mail or by voting early. That means 80% of the voters in Arizona will have cast a vote by November 1st and we are running out of time to reach them.
**President Obama himself is coming down to Arizona for a rally with Ruben this afternoon to help us get things back on track. If Obama’s coming, you know it’s serious.**
We know you can’t donate to every email we send your way. We don’t expect you to. But if you understand how critical Arizona is to our chances not just at holding the Senate but to defeating Trump, we’re hoping you’ll chip in to this one.
[**Please, Peter. Can you make your first donation — $5 or whatever’s best for you — before we reach the point of no return?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241018-3-160&t=1&akid=3393%2E734936%2EM0xVGn)

# Volunteer Newsletter Issue #4:
# Under 3 Weeks Till Election Day!
October 18th, 2024
---
|
---
| Hello Team Suozzi!
Watch Tom’s great debate with his opponent [HERE](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=a605ef594c&e=2d63ff009b).
We are excited to announce that we have three big events coming up over the next week that we want YOU to attend. We have Congressman Jim Clyburn coming to the district for a Souls to the Polls Information Brunch on October 23rd, we have a Whitestone Early Vote Rally on October 26th, and a Glen Cove Early Vote Rally on October 27th. Please look below for more information and RSVP links.
Every day, we have phone banking and canvassing opportunities available at all of our offices. If you’re looking for office work such as addressing envelopes or stuffing envelopes, stop by our Glen Cove Office at 91A School St, Glen Cove (open M-F 11am-7pm and S+S 9:30am-5:30pm). Additionally, all postcards are due back to our offices if you haven’t already done so! See below for more information on how you can help.
November 5th is right around the corner! Let’s keep up the strong momentum, and win this thing! Thank you all for your constant support. _Let’s Fix This_
Best,Sara Castelli

It’s an ambitious goal, I know, but the money we raise now could make all the difference in what happens on Election Day.
The stakes are higher than ever. You may have seen recent reports that my opponent called himself a “Nazi,” praised Hitler, and wished for the return of slavery. Those views are despicable. He CANNOT become NC’s next governor — but polling shows our race tightening and thousands of voters remain undecided.

Friend, it’s Team Brad Pfaff. With only 18 days till Election Day, we wanted to reach out to give you a sneak peek at our campaign strategy for these last essential days.
But first: our last big Public Fundraising Deadline before the election is in 3 days, and we're still $3,879 short of our Fundraising Goal. We want to make sure we’re on the same page in terms of our campaign strategy, but we can't put anything into action without the proper funds! Can we count on you to help us out by chipping $15 or more to help us reach our goal before it’s too late? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20241018_em_fr_b1_TBP_NGP]
SUPPORT BRAD TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20241018_em_fr_b1_TBP_NGP]
Friend, we don't want to take up too much of your time so here's what you need to know:
What we've been up to:
For the past year, our team has been working hard to help Brad connect with Wisconsinites across Western WI. We’ve seen an incredible outpouring of support from residents across our community—it’s clear that Wisconsinites are ready for a change of pace from the far-right agenda. Our people-powered coalition has grown exponentially, and of course, we can’t forget who we have to thank for being able to expand our outreach efforts so quickly: folks like you.
What's next:
While Brad has been able to speak, listen, and connect with tons of community members already, there are still a lot of Wisconsinites that we haven’t been able to reach yet. In order to make sure that everyone feels heard and that no one is left behind, we’ll be expanding our already robust outreach efforts to ensure that we’re able to knock on as many doors as possible before November 5th rolls around.
The stakes are higher than ever this year, Friend. Far–right extremism is rearing its ugly head all over the country, and this is especially true in Wisconsin. That’s why dedicated Democratic candidates across our state have been giving their everything so that we can retake the Senate Majority. However, this starts with protecting every single blue district from an extremist takeover—and that includes District 32, Friend.
How you can help:
Friend, grassroots support from folks like you has been the key to our campaign’s success thus far—however, we absolutely cannot slow down in the final lap of this race. In order to show our far-right opponent that our powerful coalition is here to stay, we must report our strongest number yet in our upcoming report. A donation of even $10 will go much further than you think, Friend. Will you support us before our Public Fundraising Deadline in 3 days? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20241018_em_fr_b1_TBP_NGP]
SUPPORT BRAD [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20241018_em_fr_b1_TBP_NGP]
Thank you,
Team Brad Pfaff
Brad Pfaff is a proud son of the rolling hills, coulees, and valleys of northern La Crosse County where he was raised on his family's dairy farm. Hard work, resilience, appreciation for the land, and respect for one's neighbors and community are the values that guided Brad's life. Chip in today to defend his Senate District!

What's next: While Brad has been able to speak, listen, and connect with tons of community members already, there are still a lot of Wisconsinites that we haven’t been able to reach yet. In order to make sure that everyone feels heard and that no one is left behind, we’ll be expanding our already robust outreach efforts to ensure that we’re able to knock on as many doors as possible before November 5th rolls around. The stakes are higher than ever this year, Friend. Far–right extremism is rearing its ugly head all over the country, and this is especially true in Wisconsin. That’s why dedicated Democratic candidates across our state have been giving their everything so that we can retake the Senate Majority. However, this starts with protecting every single blue district from an extremist takeover—and that includes District 32, Friend. How you can help: Friend, grassroots support from folks like you has been the key to our campaign’s success thus far—however, we absolutely cannot slow down in the final lap of this race. In order to show our far-right opponent that our powerful coalition is here to stay, we must report our strongest number yet in our upcoming report. A donation of even $10 will go much further than you think, Friend. Will you support us before our Public Fundraising Deadline in 3 days? Donald Trump is ready to gut climate protections the moment he steps foot back in the White House — and oil executives just handed him the blueprint to make it happen if he wins. **An _explosive_ new report from _The Washington Post_ just revealed that a powerful oil lobby group called the American Exploration and Production Council (AXPC), representing 30 oil and gas producers like ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips, has crafted a detailed plan to gut methane regulations, overturn key climate executive orders, and erase hard-fought environmental protections.** Their plan would allow oil companies to pollute at will — and they’re counting on Trump to help them do it. **[We need your support to fight back against Big Oil’s influence — chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can to JanePAC today to derail their dangerous agenda.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/95323022/506341063/2105508926?refcode=ea.15d137ae-8d8d-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.15d137ae-8d8d-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE1ZDEzN2FlLThkOGQtZWYxMS04NDc0LTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=h6Itd5UJq_h9DX1VaucxpRMaqShdKBYpF78ak-UUgQs=)** But it doesn’t stop there. Despite public promises to cut emissions, confidential data from AXPC reveals that many of their member companies are falling short. Nearly half of the 19 companies surveyed have _increased_ their methane emissions, some drastically. And Trump doesn’t care. **Earlier this year, he brazenly solicited a $1 billion campaign bribe from oil executives, promising to wipe out President Biden’s environmental policies in exchange for their support.** And now? They’ve handed him the exact plan to make it happen. We _have_ to fight back. **[At the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we’re mobilizing climate voters, electing climate champions, and fighting to protect the progress we’ve made. But we need your support right now to stop Trump and Big Oil from turning back the clock on climate action. name: Sunhee Volz
subject: Climate solutions need to work for all of our communities!
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
The Inflation Reduction Act made history as the largest federal investment in clean energy when it was signed into law in August 2022 by President Biden. The law makes billions of dollars available for energy efficiency and renewable energy housing upgrades. This includes upgrades and home improvements that can dramatically reduce energy bills, greenhouse gas emissions, and improve indoor air quality. Now, the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) is getting ready to roll out these programs and we need you to tell them our communities matter!
The DEP is hosting a virtual meeting on October 24th at 6pm to get public input and share information about its Home Electrification and Alliance Rebate (HEAR) program. This program will provide households with up to $14,000 in rebates for various repairs and upgrades such as new wiring, insulation, and ventilation, as well as for new electric appliances like stoves, heat pumps, water heaters, and clothes dryers. But we need your help to make sure the program is accessible for all of us. That means language access, maximum funding for lower income households, and a streamlined and transparent application process. Can you join the virtual meeting on October 24th and let the DEP know they can’t ignore our communities? [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdCiFgaQGcb1Sx6jW_3K9mwzENUtagJZI412ABakp6uGe4M7w/viewform]
Sign up for the October 24th Meeting! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdCiFgaQGcb1Sx6jW_3K9mwzENUtagJZI412ABakp6uGe4M7w/viewform?nvep=&hmac=&emci=88691c9c-c081-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
See you there!
Sunhee Volz

subject: “The IDF will continue to operate in the Gaza Strip for years to come.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

This week last year, Justice Democrats members Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib,
Summer Lee, and Delia Ramirez led the call for peace by introducing a
resolution in Congress demanding an immediate, lasting ceasefire, the
return of Israeli and Palestinian hostages, and humanitarian aid to freely
enter Gaza.

Since then, without its passage, we've witnessed mass starvation and
destruction in Gaza carried out by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin
Netanyahu and his right-wing administration. At least 41,000 Palestinians
have been killed by Israeli forces, with tens of thousands injured,
including what experts are calling “the largest cohort of child amputees
in history.”

Millions of Palestinians are displaced with no homes to return to, and
humanitarian groups continue to ring the alarm bells warning of mass
starvation and death if Israel continues to block food, water, and medical
supplies from reaching Gaza.

Despite killing multiple senior Hamas officials, the Israeli government
has already indicated that it will not withdraw from Gaza, with its
Minister of Defense proclaiming “The IDF will continue to operate in the
Gaza Strip for years to come.”

Not only has the Biden Administration continued sending Israel billions of
dollars in bombs and weapons to carry out its massacres, but it is now
sending American troops to serve on the ground alongside Israeli forces,
without getting necessary authorization from Congress.

Biden Administration officials say they’re giving Israel 30 days to
improve the humanitarian crisis in Gaza or risk losing U.S. military aid.
But 30 days is too late: millions of lives are at stake, and Israel has
shown time and again over the past year that it is unwilling to stop its
war crimes.

Once again, Justice Democrats members in Congress are leading the call for
action and accountability. It’s past time for a ceasefire: we need to
issue an arms embargo on Israel NOW.

the Israeli government commit war crimes in Gaza. We don’t need 30 days.
We don’t need more empty words. We need action. We need an arms embargo.
Retweet from CNN Breaking News: Biden administration writes to Israel
demanding it act to improve Gaza’s humanitarian crisis or risk violating
US laws governing foreign military aid.

Our progressive leaders are some of the only members of Congress listening
to the majority of voters and standing on the right side of history
demanding an end to this genocide and ethnic cleansing.

grassroots contribution of $5 or more to fuel Justice
Democrats’ Candidate Recruitment Fund in the days ahead →

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20241018?refcode=em20241018-36078&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36078_1203867_bck-8U&akid=36078%2E1203867%2Ebck-8U ]Contribute $5

The more young, diverse, working-class progressives committed to peace and
human rights that we elect to Congress, the sooner we can change the
pro-war status quo in Washington and end our nation’s complicity in this
genocide.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

In their endorsement of Kim, the Everett Herald applauded Kim for doing her best to get the job done, including getting 18 bills passed into law under two presidential administrations. She's improved access to healthcare, expanded access to broadband in our area, and even worked with Republicans to amend the farm bill to include a provision to provide whole milk to children in schools to aid in their nutritional needs. Kim is a true representation of what we want and need from our leaders. Kim delivers for each and every one of us, and now, it's time we help her win her race in just 18 days. Democrat policies had brought America to its knees.And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, “it's déjà vu all over again.”There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Kamala Harris, Gavin Newsom, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don’t care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. We've got a great way to help Joe Kent win that also gives you the opportunity to share both your enthusiasm and a glimpse of the beauty of your part of the world.
Just visit our this page on our website: [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Postcards](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/j1qVcau892u7aHLhE7892aggUQ/jFNmN9sTKpeygnT5bhrdsQ), and we'll give you the addresses of ten Republicans voters who didn't participate in the 2022 General Election (which we lost by less than 1%).
In Washington State, all voters are mailed their ballot, so please urge the voters you are writing to return their ballot as soon as possible!
While so much of the political mailers we send get put thrown in the trash without getting read, nobody throws away a handwritten postcard!
And before you drop your postcards in the mailbox, feel free to take a picture of the photo side and email that photo back to us or post it to social media with the hashtag #PostcardsforJoe.
Thank you for all your help!

Flo Rossmiller
Campaign Manager
Joe Kent for Congress

Paid for by Joe Kent for Congress

# We Must Elect Kamala
# to Protect Women’s Rights!

Dear Friend,
Women’s rights are not a partisan issue—they are fundamental human rights. As a doctor, I trust our mothers, sisters, and daughters to make the best decisions about their bodies, in consultation with their healthcare providers. With the polls tightening, this election will be decided by who can engage the most voters in these final 17 days.
It’s more critical than ever that we do everything in our power to elect Kamala Harris and Democrats up and down the ballot. Only they will work to restore and protect essential freedoms, while right-wing Republicans and Trump continue to erode women’s rights and autonomy. Together, we can make a difference.
Please donate whatever you can today to ensure the campaign has the resources to reach every single voter. Additionally, please take a moment to watch and share the campaign ad below with your network to help spread the word about what’s at stake this election.
Thank you for your continued support!
Sincerely,
Dr. Asif Mahmood

* **TOP NEWS**

"**In stunning move, Texas Supreme Court halts Robert Roberson execution in 'shaken baby' case** ," Austin American-Statesman's **Bayliss Wagner** and**John C. Moritz** -- "The Texas Supreme Court late Thursday spared **Robert Roberson** on the night he was set to die by lethal injection, a rare and head-spinning eleventh-hour decision in one of the most controversial death penalty cases in years.

The all-Republican court's decision comes in response to a first-of-its-kind legal maneuver in which a state House committee voted to subpoena Roberson for a hearing scheduled days after his execution date. It could buy Roberson -- who was set to become the first American executed for a conviction involving "shaken baby" syndrome at 6 p.m. Thursday -- weeks or months to live as court proceedings continue to play out.

The order caps a whirlwind two-day effort from a bipartisan coalition of lawmakers who feverishly fought to keep a man they believe to be innocent from the execution chamber and riveted the nation's attention on Texas' application of the death penalty.

The House representatives who led the movement expressed relief in a Thursday night [joint statement](https://substack.com/redirect/31d34f23-cb9f-4d6a-9ded-2c0d874a113a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

"For over 20 years, Robert Roberson has spent 23.5 hours of every single day in solitary confinement in a cell no bigger than the closets of most Texans, longing and striving to be heard," said Reps. **Jeff Leach** , R-Plano, and **Joe Moody** , D-El Paso. "And while some courthouses may have failed him, the Texas House has not."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/827093a3-827f-4144-8074-4f7d0ca8ad5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The drama Thursday took off when Leach and Moody successfully asked a Travis County state District Court to temporarily stay the execution to allow Roberson to answer a summons that the House Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence unanimously approved Wednesday.

The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals shortly thereafter [overturned](https://substack.com/redirect/958d5056-a6b3-4bd9-845d-aa5cc9ed594d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that [lower court's approval](https://substack.com/redirect/1be59cba-75b8-444b-9a0d-1261703603fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of [the lawmakers' request](https://substack.com/redirect/62978044-c2ee-47d9-a91c-eb516e6bb7c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a 5-4 decision, and minutes later Leach and Moody filed an [emergency motion with the Texas Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/29e9d639-f9b3-4d84-999c-8dd1cd30e86b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to intervene, arguing the Criminal Appeals Court lacked jurisdiction over a ruling made in a civil court.

Leach [posted on social media](https://substack.com/redirect/53371fff-a9d1-4d19-b3b4-58b174820faa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before the state Supreme Court's decision that he was "Praying as if everything depends on God, which it does. But working as if everything depends on us."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/827093a3-827f-4144-8074-4f7d0ca8ad5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The state Supreme Court agreed with the lawmakers, with Justice **Evan Young** writing in a [concurrence](https://substack.com/redirect/13001a32-0c35-448c-8989-23af6dd025b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "the underlying criminal-law matter is within the Court of Criminal Appeals' authority, but the relief sought here is civil in nature, as are the claims that have been presented to the district court."

Roberson's case for a reprieve has drawn widespread support from more than 80 Texas House members as well as from U.S. Supreme Court Justice **Sonia Sotomayor** , Dr. **Phil** and others.

After the U.S. Supreme Court rejected a petition to delay the execution around 4 p.m. Thursday, Sotomayor [wrote in a statement](https://substack.com/redirect/2a39235b-8f89-461b-86e9-44d7ffd1aa31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "mounting evidence suggests ... Roberson committed no crime at all."

Sotomayor and others have urged Gov. **Greg Abbott** to grant Roberson a 30-day reprieve, but the governor has remained silent on the case." [AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/6d939949-0c84-4be4-9d35-0d58f0cf45ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS "In stunning move, Texas Supreme Court halts Robert Roberson execution in 'shaken baby' case ," Austin American-Statesman's Bayliss Wagner andJohn C. Moritz -- "The Texas Supreme Court late Thursday spared Robert Roberson on the night he was set to die by lethal injection, a rare and head-spinning eleventh-hour decision in one of the most controversial death penalty cases in years. The all-Republican court's decision comes in response to a first-of-its-kind legal maneuver in which a state House committee voted to subpoena Roberson for a hearing scheduled days after his execution date. It could buy Roberson -- who was set to become the first American executed for a conviction involving "shaken baby" syndrome at 6 p.m. Thursday -- weeks or months to live as court proceedings continue to play out. The order caps a whirlwind two-day effort from a bipartisan coalition of lawmakers who feverishly fought to keep a man they believe to be innocent from the execution chamber and riveted the nation's attention on Texas' application of the death penalty. The House representatives who led the movement expressed relief in a Thursday night . "For over 20 years, Robert Roberson has spent 23.5 hours of every single day in solitary confinement in a cell no bigger than the closets of most Texans, longing and striving to be heard," said Reps. Jeff Leach , R-Plano, and Joe Moody , D-El Paso. "And while some courthouses may have failed him, the Texas House has not." The drama Thursday took off when Leach and Moody successfully asked a Travis County state District Court to temporarily stay the execution to allow Roberson to answer a summons that the House Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence unanimously approved Wednesday. The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals shortly thereafter that of in a 5-4 decision, and minutes later Leach and Moody filed an to intervene, arguing the Criminal Appeals Court lacked jurisdiction over a ruling made in a civil court. Leach before the state Supreme Court's decision that he was "Praying as if everything depends on God, which it does. But working as if everything depends on us." The state Supreme Court agreed with the lawmakers, with Justice Evan Young writing in a that "the underlying criminal-law matter is within the Court of Criminal Appeals' authority, but the relief sought here is civil in nature, as are the claims that have been presented to the district court." Roberson's case for a reprieve has drawn widespread support from more than 80 Texas House members as well as from U.S. Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor , Dr. Phil and others. After the U.S. Supreme Court rejected a petition to delay the execution around 4 p.m. Thursday, Sotomayor that "mounting evidence suggests ... Roberson committed no crime at all." Sotomayor and others have urged Gov. Greg Abbott to grant Roberson a 30-day reprieve, but the governor has remained silent on the case."
