* **TOP NEWS**

"**In stunning move, Texas Supreme Court halts Robert Roberson execution in 'shaken baby' case** ," Austin American-Statesman's **Bayliss Wagner** and**John C. Moritz** -- "The Texas Supreme Court late Thursday spared **Robert Roberson** on the night he was set to die by lethal injection, a rare and head-spinning eleventh-hour decision in one of the most controversial death penalty cases in years.

The all-Republican court's decision comes in response to a first-of-its-kind legal maneuver in which a state House committee voted to subpoena Roberson for a hearing scheduled days after his execution date. It could buy Roberson -- who was set to become the first American executed for a conviction involving "shaken baby" syndrome at 6 p.m. Thursday -- weeks or months to live as court proceedings continue to play out.

The order caps a whirlwind two-day effort from a bipartisan coalition of lawmakers who feverishly fought to keep a man they believe to be innocent from the execution chamber and riveted the nation's attention on Texas' application of the death penalty.

The House representatives who led the movement expressed relief in a Thursday night [joint statement](https://substack.com/redirect/b8d639e5-b731-4005-8d92-b785f83ff805?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

"For over 20 years, Robert Roberson has spent 23.5 hours of every single day in solitary confinement in a cell no bigger than the closets of most Texans, longing and striving to be heard," said Reps. **Jeff Leach** , R-Plano, and **Joe Moody** , D-El Paso. "And while some courthouses may have failed him, the Texas House has not."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/e2dc5b44-6ace-4d36-bde4-7ebc10b4fa76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The drama Thursday took off when Leach and Moody successfully asked a Travis County state District Court to temporarily stay the execution to allow Roberson to answer a summons that the House Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence unanimously approved Wednesday.

The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals shortly thereafter [overturned](https://substack.com/redirect/dcf70b6e-280d-4dba-9e33-0831d67120f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that [lower court's approval](https://substack.com/redirect/e1c4354f-8546-475a-967a-5c108d79fc00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of [the lawmakers' request](https://substack.com/redirect/f5a1cd32-94fe-41b4-8f06-537c92266220?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a 5-4 decision, and minutes later Leach and Moody filed an [emergency motion with the Texas Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/db10bfde-660c-4d6f-a9d1-bb405e3c11ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to intervene, arguing the Criminal Appeals Court lacked jurisdiction over a ruling made in a civil court.

Leach [posted on social media](https://substack.com/redirect/b0744e34-3f5c-4804-967d-da3f9cb27728?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before the state Supreme Court's decision that he was "Praying as if everything depends on God, which it does. But working as if everything depends on us."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/e2dc5b44-6ace-4d36-bde4-7ebc10b4fa76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The state Supreme Court agreed with the lawmakers, with Justice **Evan Young** writing in a [concurrence](https://substack.com/redirect/91115008-48be-49cc-a787-e3ab7cf85132?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "the underlying criminal-law matter is within the Court of Criminal Appeals' authority, but the relief sought here is civil in nature, as are the claims that have been presented to the district court."

Roberson's case for a reprieve has drawn widespread support from more than 80 Texas House members as well as from U.S. Supreme Court Justice **Sonia Sotomayor** , Dr. **Phil** and others.

After the U.S. Supreme Court rejected a petition to delay the execution around 4 p.m. Thursday, Sotomayor [wrote in a statement](https://substack.com/redirect/22c431fb-e44e-4a16-be08-4741c2066e48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "mounting evidence suggests ... Roberson committed no crime at all."

Sotomayor and others have urged Gov. **Greg Abbott** to grant Roberson a 30-day reprieve, but the governor has remained silent on the case." [AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/946267aa-865f-48e1-a0fb-3c06ec9fd33c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

Moritz -- "The Texas Supreme Court late Thursday spared Robert Roberson on the night he was set to die by lethal injection, a rare and head-spinning eleventh-hour decision in one of the most controversial death penalty cases in years. The all-Republican court's decision comes in response to a first-of-its-kind legal maneuver in which a state House committee voted to subpoena Roberson for a hearing scheduled days after his execution date. It could buy Roberson -- who was set to become the first American executed for a conviction involving "shaken baby" syndrome at 6 p.m. Thursday -- weeks or months to live as court proceedings continue to play out. The order caps a whirlwind two-day effort from a bipartisan coalition of lawmakers who feverishly fought to keep a man they believe to be innocent from the execution chamber and riveted the nation's attention on Texas' application of the death penalty. The House representatives who led the movement expressed relief in a Thursday night . "For over 20 years, Robert Roberson has spent 23.5 hours of every single day in solitary confinement in a cell no bigger than the closets of most Texans, longing and striving to be heard," said Reps. Jeff Leach , R-Plano, and Joe Moody , D-El Paso. "And while some courthouses may have failed him, the Texas House has not." The drama Thursday took off when Leach and Moody successfully asked a Travis County state District Court to temporarily stay the execution to allow Roberson to answer a summons that the House Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence unanimously approved Wednesday. The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals shortly thereafter that of in a 5-4 decision, and minutes later Leach and Moody filed an to intervene, arguing the Criminal Appeals Court lacked jurisdiction over a ruling made in a civil court. Leach before the state Supreme Court's decision that he was "Praying as if everything depends on God, which it does. But working as if everything depends on us." The state Supreme Court agreed with the lawmakers, with Justice Evan Young writing in a that "the underlying criminal-law matter is within the Court of Criminal Appeals' authority, but the relief sought here is civil in nature, as are the claims that have been presented to the district court." Roberson's case for a reprieve has drawn widespread support from more than 80 Texas House members as well as from U.S. Supreme Court Justice Sonia Sotomayor , Dr. Phil and others. After the U.S. Supreme Court rejected a petition to delay the execution around 4 p.m. Thursday, Sotomayor that "mounting evidence suggests ... Roberson committed no crime at all." Sotomayor and others have urged Gov. Greg Abbott to grant Roberson a 30-day reprieve, but the governor has remained silent on the case." CNN: Florida, West Virginia and Missouri withdraw from bipartisan effort aimed at maintaining accurate voter rolls [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/CNN_ERIC_Withdrawl.png]
The Electronic Registration Information Center, also known as ERIC, is a nonprofit system that helps participating states keep their registration rolls accurate and up to date by analyzing voter data and sharing reports with members , in order for them to update their voter rolls, remove ineligible voters and investigate potential voter fraud.
States from Florida, West Virginia and Missouri to Alabama, Louisiana and Texas withdrew in the last year. Virginia withdrew as well, and after the state legislature passed a bill this year to rejoin, their governor, an opponent of voting rights, vetoed the bill. Critics of the withdrawals have argued that leaving ERIC will make it harder to verify that voter rolls are up to date in each state .
We want to hear from voters in your area about this tactic. Will you take our one-click poll right away?

| Peter,

We have a great tradition of service here in New Hampshire with a deep sense of commitment to serving our communities.

Growing up, my dad always said that he got his education in the United States Navy. I was proud to follow in my dad’s footsteps and serve in the Navy Reserve as an intelligence officer for 11 years.

One of the greatest lessons I learned serving in the Navy was that sometimes, you have to work with people who you may not see eye to eye with, but you learn how to work together to complete the mission at hand and get the job done.

subject: 18 Days to Go...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jeremy Shaffer
body:
Vote In Person this Weekend at North Park! | | | | |
---
| [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/72782a0f8cae/im-running-and-i-need-your-support-12714880?e=8c80cba7e7)
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=28885e7425&e=8c80cba7e7)
| | | | | Dear ,
I’m so grateful for the incredible energy and support you’ve shown our campaign over these past few months. With just 18 days until November 5th, every conversation, every volunteer hour, and banking every vote is crucial.
**Make a Plan to Vote!**
This weekend, early voting will take place at the North Park Ice Rink from 9 AM to 5 PM on both Saturday (10/19) and Sunday (10/20). Any Allegheny County resident can vote in person or return their mail-in ballot during these hours. I strongly encourage you to cast your vote now rather than waiting until Election Day. While we all plan to vote on the 5th, unexpected events can arise. Last year, we witnessed issues like polling places running out of ballots and power outages disrupting the process. Voting early not only helps you but also supports all our GOP candidates!
---
[FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=92cc00bcd6&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Join Us for a Day of Action!**
This Saturday from 12 PM to 3 PM, we’re teaming up with Rob Mercuri for a door-knocking campaign. We’ll meet at the Starbucks on Route 8 in Richland (517 Grandview Crossing, Gibsonia, PA 15044) at noon. Any time you can contribute would be greatly appreciated!
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=c6c10e7b85&e=8c80cba7e7)
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=794835cec5&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Election Day Volunteers Needed!**
We need your help on Election Day! There are 26 voting locations in our district, each open from 7 AM to 8 PM. Can you assist by passing out information at one of these sites? Any amount of time you can spare would be invaluable. We’ll provide all the materials and instructions you need. If you’re interested, please reply to this email! We also need volunteers to distribute information this weekend and next at North Park.
**So Much Happening in Our Community!**
I’ve been actively attending various events, including the Pittsburgh Chamber North Candidate Meet and Greet in Marshall Township. I even took some time to bring my youngest daughter to the new Northern Tier Library branch at the Pine Community Center. Did you know I’ve served a combined 12 years on the Northland Library Foundation Board and the Northern Tier Library Board? I’m committed to volunteering in our community and will work just as hard in Harrisburg to make Pennsylvania better for everyone!
---
[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=571adb76cd&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Support Our Campaign**

I’m grateful to be backed by former PA State House Speaker Mike Turzai, who represented the 28th District with distinction. He’s hosting a fundraiser for our campaign on October 21st. If you’re able, please consider supporting us.
---

| Thank you for your continued support as we approach this critical moment!
To Victory,

Any Allegheny County resident can vote in person or return their mail-in ballot during these hours. I strongly encourage you to cast your vote now rather than waiting until Election Day. While we all plan to vote on the 5th, unexpected events can arise. Last year, we witnessed issues like polling places running out of ballots and power outages disrupting the process. Voting early not only helps you but also supports all our GOP candidates! | Join Us for a Day of Action! This Saturday from 12 PM to 3 PM, we’re teaming up with Rob Mercuri for a door-knocking campaign. We’ll meet at the Starbucks on Route 8 in Richland (517 Grandview Crossing, Gibsonia, PA 15044) at noon. Any time you can contribute would be greatly appreciated! | Election Day Volunteers Needed! We need your help on Election Day! There are 26 voting locations in our district, each open from 7 AM to 8 PM. Can you assist by passing out information at one of these sites? Any amount of time you can spare would be invaluable. We’ll provide all the materials and instructions you need. If you’re interested, please reply to this email! We also need volunteers to distribute information this weekend and next at North Park. So Much Happening in Our Community! I’ve been actively attending various events, including the Pittsburgh Chamber North Candidate Meet and Greet in Marshall Township. I even took some time to bring my youngest daughter to the new Northern Tier Library branch at the Pine Community Center. Did you know I’ve served a combined 12 years on the Northland Library Foundation Board and the Northern Tier Library Board? I’m committed to volunteering in our community and will work just as hard in Harrisburg to make Pennsylvania better for everyone! | Support Our Campaign I’m grateful to be backed by former PA State House Speaker Mike Turzai, who represented the 28th District with distinction. He’s hosting a fundraiser for our campaign on October 21st. If you’re able, please consider supporting us. | Thank you for your continued support as we approach this critical moment! We thought you may be interested to receive this conservative news alert from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Adcock: Communists Always Eat Their Own, Rep. Sean Casten (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/adcock-communists-always-eat-their-own-rep-sean-casten.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=db028230cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

U.S. Rep. Sean Casten (D, IL-06), who defeated a challenge by Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau by nearly 10 points in 2022 and now faces a challenge by single mother and Glen Ellyn resident Niki Conforti (https://conforti4congress.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=db028230cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , leaves the U.S. Capitol in September 2024. (Photo: Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call via Getty Images)
By Shannon Adcock (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/author/shannonadcock?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=db028230cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , Opinion Contributor

It’s not about ideology, it’s about power.

On October 17, 2024, Congressional Rep. Sean Casten’s (D-06) town hall at Indian Prairie Library in Darien was shut down due to protestor disruption. It’s a shame to see any public forum get shut down due to agitated disruptors. As the leader of a social welfare advocacy organization, I believe free discourse should free flow in a free Republic.

Sadly, Rep. Sean Casten is now experiencing how his Democrat Party and leftist ideologues do not seek discourse. Rather, they skip straight to destruction.

In stunning irony, Rep. Casten is getting canceled by the very culture he helped breed.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/10/adcock-communists-always-eat-their-own-rep-sean-casten.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=db028230cd-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
For years, Sean Casten has spread heinous lies about our organization Awake Illinois with the hopes of silencing us. In October 2022, we proudly led a grassroots awareness campaign to inform people of the Drag Queen Bingo event Downers Grove Library intended to host for minors. Internet searches of the scheduled Drag Queen resulted in graphic images. Parental notification wasn’t required and it is unknown who had access to child registration information. Walking into the library on October 3rd to provide public comment, I was met with antagonistic jeering. Cutting through the fog of hate permeating the meeting hall, I smiled and awaited my turn to speak – determined to represent the common sense citizens who stand against child exploitation.

The remarks went viral.

subject: They were abandoned by Jordan. Now they're endorsing Tamie
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Hey friends - Team Tamie here with a HUGE announcement!
Today, we're proud to announce that the brave Ohio State University abuse victims, Jim Jordan’s former students, have endorsed Tamie Wilson for Congress.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_osu_victims_button [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_osu_victims_button]
These men, some of whom Jordan personally recruited, were subjected to horrific abuse by their team doctor.
And what did Jordan do?
Nothing.
He knew about the abuse and chose to look the other way, failing to protect the young men he was supposed to mentor.
Let that sink in: Jim Jordan – a man who claims to be a fighter – ran away when it came to standing up for the people who trusted him the most.
That’s why we’re fighting back. It’s time to hold Jordan accountable for his deplorable cowardice. Can you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today to help us make sure Jordan faces justice? Every dollar helps us reach more voters and expose the truth. We have 20 days left – let’s not waste a single one. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_osu_victims_link1]
Unlike Jim Jordan, Tamie has stood by these survivors every step of the way. She has consistently uplifted their stories and has even gone to court with them.
In fact, she held an action at the DNC that made national headlines, making sure the entire country knows about Jordan’s disgraceful behavior.
Tamie is a fighter for those who have felt abandoned, left behind, and forgotten by our government.
She’s fighting for justice, and she’s not afraid to call out Jordan’s fraudulent and cowardice behavior.
If Jim Jordan abandons his own recruits to protect his own career, just imagine the damage he could do as Speaker of the House.
What heinous crimes will he cover-up, then, at what price, and to what highest bidder?
What dangerous, far-right agenda will he push through Congress while ignoring the needs of the people he’s supposed to represent?
This is why Tamie Wilson’s leadership is so important.
Tamie is hard at work getting a bipartisan bill she authored passed in Congress. It’s a bill that supports survivors of sexual abuse and ensures they receive the justice they deserve.
She’s not just talking about change – she’s making it happen.
Unlike Jordan, Tamie is actually fighting for the people .
Jordan’s in a tailspin because he knows we’re closing in. He even admitted in an interview that he might lose this race.
We’ve got him on the run, but we can’t let up now.
Will you rush a contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today to ensure we have the resources to finish strong and deliver justice for those Jim Jordan abandoned? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_osu_victims_link2]
This is the most important congressional race in the country. We have the opportunity to remove a coward from Congress and replace him with someone who will fight for justice, integrity, and real change.
Let’s keep the momentum going – together, we can win this race and make history. Join us today, contribute to the fight, and help us send Jim Jordan packing.
Let’s win this!
Team Tamie
PS: If you can join us making phone calls, knocking on doors, or a number of other things, please sign up ASAP here. [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]
Donate to Tamie Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241018_osu_victims_button]
Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

| | |
# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 18, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com
**Terra Lawson-Remer Wants a Promotion Despite Missing Work and Skipping Every Homeless Task Force Meeting She Leads**
SAN DIEGO, CA – Terra Lawson-Remer, who currently serves as Vice Chair of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors, is now[ seeking to become Chair](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=68cbfe8ad3&e=784f78234b) of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors—but her record raises serious questions about her fitness for the role. Lawson-Remer has failed to show up for key meetings, missed important votes, and has not attended a single session of the Continuum of Care Board—the homeless task force she co-leads—despite claiming that addressing homelessness is her top priority.
**“Why would someone who can’t be bothered to show up for work think they deserve a promotion?” said Kevin Faulconer, candidate for County Supervisor. “In the real world, if you miss meetings and don’t do your job, you get fired—not promoted. But because of her privileged position, Lawson-Remer seems to think she deserves a pass. That’s not how public service works, and it’s certainly not the leadership San Diego County needs. She’s so out of touch that she thinks she deserves a promotion after doing nothing for four years as Supervisor.”**
Lawson-Remer’s record shows a troubling pattern: while homelessness and homeless deaths in San Diego have reached a 10-year high, she has skipped every meeting of the very task force responsible for addressing the crisis. Additionally, she has missed critical votes and board meetings—something no ordinary employee could get away with without facing consequences. Yet, in the midst of an election year, Lawson-Remer is not only asking for re-election but [also seeking a promotion](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=0cdc9371be&e=784f78234b) to Chair the San Diego Board of Supervisors.
Her actions reflect a deep lack of seriousness about solving the homelessness problem that has plagued San Diego’s streets and stands in deep contrast with Kevin Faulconer’s record of action. As mayor of San Diego, Faulconer implemented solutions to help reduce homelessness by double digits even as other cities around the state saw double digit increases.
As Supervisor, Kevin Faulconer is committed to ensuring San Diego residents get the leadership they deserve—leaders who show up, do the job, and deliver real, tangible results.###

clean_body: | | | | | Hi Friend , Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! Thanks to voting by mail, today and every day until Tuesday, November 5th, is Election Day.#WhenWeVoteWeWin | NPP ON THE GROUND | | All hands on deck The voter registration deadline is on Monday, October 21st at 11:59PM, which means this weekend is our last chance to ensure that voters are registered to vote. Our team will be on the ground in all of our regions, working to register as many voters as possible.Starting on Tuesday, October 22nd we will launch our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) campaign, making sure people get their voting plans ready ahead of the highly consequential November 5th elections. | Our regional organizing director, Connie, is training a new team member, Brandon. | | Registering shoppers in Philadelphia | | Luzerne County Community College, Hazleton Campus | | Philly team launch Voter registration outside a laundromat in the Lehigh Valley | | | | Meeting voters where they are, in Philadelphia | | City Hall, Philadelphia, with Commissioner Omar Sabir | | | | | | | Georgia is breaking records on early voting. In Pennsylvania, a way to vote before November 5th, is via mail-in ballots.As of now, all Pennsylvania counties have mail-in ballots available.Remember,Tuesday, October 29th is the last day to request a mail-in ballot , and your county election office must receive the ballot by 8 pm on Tuesday, November 5th for it to be counted. | | | | | | | | Liberty and Independence Ball Saturday, October 26th, 6-11PM Mount Airy Casino and Resort 312 Woodland Rd, Mt Pocono, PA 18344 Founding CEO, Kadida Kenner, will be an honoree and keynote speaker at this year's NAACP Freedom Fund Gala.We hope to see you there!General Admission: $75 VIP Admission: $100 (Includes open bar during cocktail hour) Student Admission: $50 (Student ID Required) | | | | CD1 Candidate Forum: U.S. House of Representatives Tuesday, October 22nd, 6:30-7:30PM Bucks County Community College Gallagher Room (Inside the Rollins Center) 275 Swamp Rd Newtown, PA 18940 Please join the New Pennsylvania Project for a candidate forum with Ashley Ehasz (Democrat).All candidates for CD1 were invited to participate. Current incumbent, U.S. Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick (R) was invited to attend; unfortunately, as of this newsletter, we have yet to receive a response from his campaign. | | | Candidate Forum: PA Attorney General Tuesday, October 29th, 6:30-7:30PM Online via Zoom Please join the New Pennsylvania Project for a virtual candidate forum with Eugene DePasquale (Democrat) and Eric Settle (Forward Party). All candidates for the Attorney General race, including third party candidates, were invited to participate. DePasquale and Settle were the only candidates to confirm their attendance as of this newsletter. | | | | CD17 Candidate Forum: U.S. House of Representatives Tuesday, October 29th, 12-1PM Online via Zoom Please join the New PA Project Education Fund, and organizational partner 1Hood, for a virtual candidate forum with Congressman Chris Deluzio (D). All candidates for CD17 were invited to participate, including state Rep. Rob Mercuri (R). Unfortunately, as of this newsletter, we have yet to receive a response from his campaign. | | | | Party at the Polls: Harrisburg Friday, November 1st 12-2PM Market Square 2nd and Market St. Harrisburg, PA 17111 Let's celebrate democracy! Bring the family, enjoy free food, DJ, giveaways, and more! | | | PA Family Voting Party with Moms Rising | | | | | New Pennsylvania Project CEO, Kadida Kenner was one of many presenters at the PA Family Voting Party, held on Thursday virtually. It was a night filled with civic education, as well as tips on mail-in and early voting, actions for protecting the vote, activities for the kids, and more. | Article by Caroline Craig published on October 9, 2024 at the Bucks County Beacon “Ehasz announced in a statement Wednesday she would participate in the forum hosted by New Pennsylvania Project, while Fitzpatrick has not yet accepted the invitation – or Ehasz’s debate challenge. The New Pennsylvania Project is a nonpartisan voting rights organization focusing on voter registration, civic education, and mobilization. The group will host the PA-01 candidate forum open to the public and press on Oct. 22, with the location to be announced in the coming days.” | | | NPP live on Canela TV on October 14th Ourdirector of strategic communications, Gabriela Huerta , represented New Pennsylvania Project on Canela TV this week, discussing why Black and Latino voters are so important for the U.S. Election. | | | “The U.S. Supreme Court said Monday it would not hear an appeal by members of the Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus in a challenge of Gov. Josh Shapiro’s order implementing automatic voter registration in the commonwealth.” “A northeastern Pennsylvania county where ballot paper shortages caused problems during the 2022 election — halting some voting and requiring a judge to extend poll hours — has settled a lawsuit by agreeing to ensure sufficient paper will be ordered for future elections. Luzerne County signed off last week on the settlement with two voters who, as a result of the paper shortages, were unable to cast ballots in that election at polling places in Freeland and Shickshinny.” “Tensions were high as Luzerne County residents expressed mixed opinions on whether the drop boxes should stay or go for the upcoming election. I'm immunocompromised, and so is my daughter; it's the way we prefer to vote to keep ourselves safe," said Hannah Butterwick, Dallas Township. Eliminating drop boxes does not disenfranchise anyone's voter; contrary to theatrics, it does not take away anyone's vote," said Robin Coshan, Dallas Township.” | “Pennsylvania voters are more likely to trust local election results over presidential ones, with overall confidence in the integrity of voting systems split along partisan lines, a new Spotlight PA poll shows.Voting experts were encouraged by the poll’s finding that voter confidence is strongest at the county level, which is where most responsibility for administering elections lies in Pennsylvania.” “During the November 2022 election Philadelphia processed ballots at a rate of 5,000 per hour, while Allegheny County, home to Pittsburgh and surrounding municipalities, processed more than 12,000 ballots per hour, based on an analysis of information provided by the counties, publicly available data, and data from the Pennsylvania Department of State.” “City Council advanced legislation Wednesday that’s designed to hold corporate landlords accountable for “price-fixing” rental rates in Philadelphia. Under the antitrust measure, violators could be sued and face stiff fines for coordinating monthly rent, an illegal practice housing advocates say hurts low-income renters by undermining competition and fairness in the marketplace amid an affordable housing crisis.” “The presidential election will likely come down to Pennsylvania — just as it did in 2020 — and voter turnout in Philadelphia could determine who wins the Keystone State and becomes the next president. Given Philadelphia’s outsized role in deciding elections statewide, city officials should be doing everything possible to increase voter registration and boost turnout. But instead of an all-out push for new and inspiring ways to get out the vote, the effort appears to largely be business as usual.” “Lawmakers in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on Wednesday approved a series of bills that would enshrine protections outlined in the federal Affordable Care Act into state law in the event that former President Barack Obama’s signature health care law is repealed or invalidated at the federal level.” “The number of women legislators in Pennsylvania’s General Assembly who have school-age children has increased exponentially in the past two years according to a new report, and that representation is reflected in some of the policy initiatives that the legislature has put forth.” “To address these historical restrictions, Pennsylvania passed a law in December that allows property owners to file a one-page form that gets attached to the deed and disavows and nullifies discriminatory language in it. The free form is submitted to the local county’s Recorder of Deeds office...“The law allows property owners to void the discriminatory language from the time it was first recorded. “We’re taking its power away. And that, to me, is worthwhile.”” | | | General Election: Tuesday, November 5, 2024 Last day to register to vote: Monday, October 21, 2024 Last day to request mail-in ballot: Tuesday, October 29, 2024 Important Links: Voter Hotlines: Voter Protection Hotline: 1-866-OUR-VOTEDOS PA Voter Hotline: 1-877-VOTESPA Spanish/English Hotline: 1-866-VE-Y-VOTAAsian Languages Hotline: 1-888-API-VOTE Arabic/English Hotline: 1-844-YALLA-US | | Our Contact Information New Pennsylvania Project P.O. Box 443 West Chester, PA 19381 4126996771 | | | | | ---|---|---

Friday, October 18, 2024 | Peter-- Here is your weekly **Forward Friends** volunteer update! Only two and a half weeks until the big day, how are you feeling? _Last Week’s Highlights:_ To those of you who tried to attend the Meet the Forwardists event this past Monday and were not able to get in, I do apologize. There will be a recording available soon. In other news, we onboarded 8 new people to CallHub this week and have sent over 13,000 texts. We uploaded a new candidate, with three more on the way, and completed one as well. Way to go team! _Upcoming Opportunities:_
* We will resume our usual [Monday Night Madness](meet.google.com/ssu-wudq-uxd) phone/text banking party this Monday the 21st at 8pm ET. You still have time to join us and possibly win some merch!
* The Black Voters Committee is hosting a textbank on Wed, Oct 23rd at 7pm ET, you can signup [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/black_voters_committee_virtual_textbank?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_4&n=2)
* I will be hosting a Meet the Forwardists Part 2, with Gov Christine Todd Whitman and CEO Lindsey Williams Drath on Wed Oct 30th, at 8pm ET. We will have a new round of candidates to introduce you to, you don't want to miss it! You can register [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=fTauy-itwlWmXjZxdHIXXR-11B7KZpevUULIwFXjp5Bo27ZZJbvL0K0zau9B_Qm21SoGrjaG4uwytXtKD0Id8UZ2-SsiiEANxJ8IKdVIiMc&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=forward_friends_4&n=3)

_Candidate Spotlight:_ Madison Grainger is running for a seat on the County Board in Arlington, VA. She is a first time candidate, and was inspired to run through her volunteer efforts with the Virginia Forward party. We are so proud to have her running as a Forward candidate, you can learn more about her at [madison4countyboard.com](madison4countyboard.com). As always, I appreciate everyone who takes the time to read these and get involved, we can't do it without awesome volunteers like you. Hope you all have a wonderful weekend! Carrie Anne Templeton

It is time for us to send a message to all the politicians who held our careers, education, retirement, and freedom for ransom with the COVID-19 vaccine mandates. **All across our district, we are door-knocking, attending events, and meeting new people!**

**It was great seeing many familiar faces there. Check out some photos below!**

|

**$10, $20, $50, or $100 to our race, can be all the difference in achieving victory for our campaign. **

If I were to go back in time and talk to baby me (_pictured above_), that’s what I would tell her.
Not that it’s going to be easy.
Not that anything is guaranteed.
I would tell her that when we show up and show out, when we come together in action, we achieve great things. _We make good things happen._
**Tomorrow is big and we _need_ good things to happen — it’s the first day of in-person early voting!** Tomorrow, Nevadans will head to early vote centers and our votes will determine the trajectory of our nation.
**_I can feel it so clearly, moments like this when we’re on the verge of making history._**
I was elected as the first Black woman chair of the Nevada State Democratic Party and together we’ve built a team that reflects the diversity of our great battleground state.
Tomorrow, our nation’s first Black president, Barack Obama will rally voters in Vegas to cast their ballots for Kamala Harris.
_If_ we do our jobs right and tell the truth with Nevadans about their choice at the ballot box, **we will make history**. We will elect a strong Black woman of humble beginnings, raised by a single immigrant mother, with decades of experience in public service, as our next president.
We cannot take these next 18 days for granted. Control of Congress, of the Senate, and the White House could all come down to a few thousand votes in Nevada. Every action we take now will make all the difference. Don’t wake up on November 6 with regrets.

clean_body: Tomorrow, Nevadans will head to early vote centers and our votes will determine the trajectory of our nation | | | | Hey friends, Good things happen when we show up and show out. If I were to go back in time and talk to baby me (pictured above), that’s what I would tell her. Not that it’s going to be easy. Not that anything is guaranteed. I would tell her that when we show up and show out, when we come together in action, we achieve great things. We make good things happen. Tomorrow is big and we need good things to happen — it’s the first day of in-person early voting! Tomorrow, Nevadans will head to early vote centers and our votes will determine the trajectory of our nation. I can feel it so clearly, moments like this when we’re on the verge of making history. I was elected as the first Black woman chair of the Nevada State Democratic Party and together we’ve built a team that reflects the diversity of our great battleground state. Tomorrow, our nation’s first Black president, Barack Obama will rally voters in Vegas to cast their ballots for Kamala Harris. If we do our jobs right and tell the truth with Nevadans about their choice at the ballot box, we will make history. We will elect a strong Black woman of humble beginnings, raised by a single immigrant mother, with decades of experience in public service, as our next president. We cannot take these next 18 days for granted. Control of Congress, of the Senate, and the White House could all come down to a few thousand votes in Nevada. Every action we take now will make all the difference. Don’t wake up on November 6 with regrets. [ ]() Barn cats have pretty important jobs on the farm. Oiler here keeps the mice out of my shop—but I couldn’t get him to hand me the wrench. Can you give me a hand? [**Will you split a donation to help Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats and our campaign get the tools we need to win this race? Mitch McConnell is hellbent on defeating me, so I’d appreciate anything you can give »**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55089?t=7&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Jon Tester will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55090?t=8&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55091?t=9&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55092?t=10&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55093?t=11&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55094?t=12&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)
Today’s fundraising deadline is just hours away—and it’s the most important one yet. But right now, our fundraising just isn’t where it needs to be. Money has been slowing down at the worst possible time, right as Tim Sheehy’s super PAC buddies are _ramping up_ their attacks to win this seat.

We can’t afford to cede the airwaves right as Montanans are going to the polls, which means we have to hit every one of our fundraising goals. **My finance director says we have to raise another $200K by the end of the day to stay on pace.**
[**I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t critical for our campaign. Will you split $10 or more right now to help me overcome their latest attacks and help Fight for Reform elect state and local Democrats? »**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55089?t=13&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Jon Tester will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55090?t=14&akid=22344%2E4449941%2E0sc4ef)

Thank you,

Jon

This week on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6.
And what was his response? He laughed!!
There's nothing funny about this, y'all.
I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.
First, I heard the glass break. Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son: "Whatever happens, I love you."
I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.
But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet .
In just 19 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve.
But after this week’s debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck.
There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it.
